beginning.example: The beginning of the story was slow, but it became interesting later.
beginning.exampleZh: 故事的开头很慢，但后来变得有趣了。

behind.example: The little boy hid behind the big tree during the game.
behind.exampleZh: 游戏期间，小男孩躲在那棵大树后面。

believe.example: I believe you can finish this easy job today.
believe.exampleZh: 我相信你今天能完成这项简单的工作。

bell.example: The school bell rang loudly and all the students went back to class.
bell.exampleZh: 学校的铃声响亮地响起，所有学生都回教室了。

belong.example: These books belong to my sister and her two children.
belong.exampleZh: 这些书属于我姐姐和她的两个孩子。

below.example: Please write your name below the line on the paper.
below.exampleZh: 请把名字写在纸上那条线的下方。

beside.example: She sat beside the window and read a book quietly.
beside.exampleZh: 她坐在窗边安静地看书。

besides.example: Besides English, she also studies French and likes reading books.
besides.exampleZh: 除了英语，她还学法语，并且喜欢读书。

best.example: She is my best friend and we study together every day.
best.exampleZh: 她是我最好的朋友，我们每天一起学习。

better.example: I feel better today, so I will go back to school.
better.exampleZh: 我今天感觉好多了，所以我会回学校。

between.example: There is a small park between the school and the library.
between.exampleZh: 学校和图书馆之间有一个小公园。

beyond.example: The small village lies beyond the river and the old bridge.
beyond.exampleZh: 那个小村庄位于河流和旧桥的那一边。

big.example: This is a big problem for our small team.
big.exampleZh: 这对我们这个小团队来说是个大问题。

bike.example: I ride my bike to school every day because it is fast and fun.
bike.exampleZh: 我每天骑自行车上学，因为它又快又有趣。

bill.example: Please pay this bill before the end of the month.
bill.exampleZh: 请在这个月底之前付清这张账单。

bird.example: The little bird is singing a happy song in the tree.
bird.exampleZh: 那只小鸟正在树上唱着一首欢快的歌。

birth.example: She gave birth to a healthy baby boy last night.
birth.exampleZh: 她昨晚生了一个健康的男婴。

birthday.example: My sister's birthday is next Friday, and we will have a small party at home.
birthday.exampleZh: 我妹妹的生日是下周五，我们会在家里办一个小聚会。

biscuit.example: She gave the little boy a biscuit and a glass of milk.
biscuit.exampleZh: 她给了小男孩一块饼干和一杯牛奶。

bit.example: I am a bit tired after work today.

black.example: The black cat sits by the old wooden door and waits for its owner.
black.exampleZh: 那只黑猫坐在旧木门旁，等着它的主人。

blackboard.example: The teacher wrote the new words on the blackboard for us.
blackboard.exampleZh: 老师在黑板上给我们写了新单词。

blind.example: The blind man crosses the busy street with his helpful guide dog every morning.
blind.exampleZh: 这位盲人每天早上在他那只有用的导盲犬的陪伴下穿过繁忙的街道。

block.example: A fallen tree can block the road after a storm.
block.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，一棵倒下的树会阻塞道路。

blood.example: The doctor cleaned the blood from the small cut on his knee.
blood.exampleZh: 医生清理了他膝盖上小伤口流出的血。

blow.example: The strong wind began to blow all the leaves off the old tree.
blow.exampleZh: 强风开始把老树上的叶子都吹落。

blue.example: She felt a little blue after her best friend moved away last week.
blue.exampleZh: 她最好的朋友上周搬走后，她感到有点忧郁。

board.example: The board met this morning to discuss the new school budget.
board.exampleZh: 董事会今天上午开会讨论新的学校预算。

boat.example: We took a small boat across the lake and enjoyed the cool wind.
boat.exampleZh: 我们乘一艘小船穿过湖面，享受着凉爽的风。

body.example: Regular exercise keeps your body strong and healthy.
body.exampleZh: 经常锻炼能让你的身体强壮又健康。

boil.example: Water will boil faster if you put a lid on the pot.
boil.exampleZh: 如果你给锅盖上盖子，水会更快沸腾。

book.example: I want to book a room for two nights in this hotel.
book.exampleZh: 我想在这家酒店预订一个房间，住两晚。

bookshop.example: I went to the new bookshop near my house to buy a book.
bookshop.exampleZh: 我去我家附近的新书店买了一本书。

boring.example: Our history class was so boring that I almost fell asleep.
boring.exampleZh: 我们的历史课太无聊了，我差点睡着。

born.example: She was born in a small town near the sea.
born.exampleZh: 她出生在一个海边的小镇。

borrow.example: May I borrow your pen for a moment, please?
borrow.exampleZh: 我可以借用一下你的笔吗？

boss.example: My boss gave me a new task to finish before Friday.
boss.exampleZh: 我的老板给了我一个新任务，要在星期五之前完成。

both.example: Both of my parents like to walk in the park after dinner.
both.exampleZh: 我父母都喜欢晚饭后去公园散步。

bottle.example: She put the cold water in a clean bottle for the trip.
bottle.exampleZh: 她把冷水装进一个干净的瓶子里，准备路上喝。

bottom.example: She found her keys at the bottom of the old bag.
bottom.exampleZh: 她在旧包的底部找到了钥匙。

bowl.example: She put the hot soup into a large bowl on the table.
bowl.exampleZh: 她把热汤倒进桌上的一个大碗里。

box.example: She put the old books in a big box under her bed.
box.exampleZh: 她把旧书放进床底下的一个大箱子里。

boy.example: The little boy is playing with his red ball in the park.
boy.exampleZh: 这个小男孩正在公园里玩他的红球。

brain.example: Your brain needs enough sleep to work well every day.
brain.exampleZh: 你的大脑需要充足的睡眠才能每天良好运转。

brave.example: The brave firefighter ran into the burning house to save the little girl.
brave.exampleZh: 那位勇敢的消防员冲进燃烧的房子去救那个小女孩。

bread.example: I bought fresh bread from the small bakery near my house today.
bread.exampleZh: 我今天从家附近的小面包店买了新鲜面包。

break.example: I need to take a short break after working for two hours.
break.exampleZh: 工作两个小时后，我需要短暂休息一下。

breakfast.example: I always eat a quick breakfast before I leave for work in the morning.
breakfast.exampleZh: 我早上上班前总是很快吃顿早餐。

breath.example: She took a deep breath before she spoke to the crowd.
breath.exampleZh: 她在对人群讲话前深吸了一口气。

breathe.example: Please breathe slowly and deeply through your nose.
breathe.exampleZh: 请用鼻子慢慢地深呼吸。

bridge.example: They walked across the old bridge to reach the other side of the river.
bridge.exampleZh: 他们走过那座旧桥，到达河的另一边。

bright.example: The bright sun made the whole room warm and cheerful.
bright.exampleZh: 明亮的阳光让整个房间温暖又愉快。

bring.example: Please bring your notebook to class tomorrow morning.
bring.exampleZh: 请明天早上把笔记本带到课上。

brother.example: My brother helps me with my homework every day after school.
brother.exampleZh: 我哥哥每天放学后帮我做作业。

brown.example: She has brown eyes and a brown bag on the chair.
brown.exampleZh: 她有一双棕色的眼睛，椅子上还有一个棕色包。

brush.example: She used a small brush to paint the wall bright blue.
brush.exampleZh: 她用一把小刷子把墙刷成亮蓝色。

build.example: They plan to build a new school near the park next year.
build.exampleZh: 他们计划明年在公园附近建一所新学校。

building.example: The new building on our street is tall and very modern.
building.exampleZh: 我们街上的新大楼很高，而且非常现代。

burn.example: Be careful not to burn your hand on the hot pan.
burn.exampleZh: 小心别让热锅烫伤你的手。

bus.example: I take the bus to school every morning at seven.
bus.exampleZh: 我每天早上七点乘公共汽车去学校。

business.example: My father runs a small business in our town and enjoys his work.
business.exampleZh: 我父亲在我们镇上经营一家小公司，他很喜欢自己的工作。

busy.example: My mother is busy cooking dinner for our family in the kitchen.
busy.exampleZh: 我妈妈正在厨房里忙着为家人做晚饭。

but.example: I wanted to go out, but it rained all day.
but.exampleZh: 我想出去，但是下了一整天雨。

butter.example: I put some butter on my bread before I eat breakfast.
butter.exampleZh: 我在吃早餐前在面包上放了一些黄油。

butterfly.example: A butterfly landed on the flower in our small garden.
butterfly.exampleZh: 一只蝴蝶落在了我们小花园里的花上。

button.example: He pressed the button and the door opened slowly.
button.exampleZh: 他按下按钮，门慢慢打开了。

buy.example: I want to buy some fresh fruit for my family today.
buy.exampleZh: 我今天想给家人买一些新鲜水果。

by.example: I go to school by bus every morning with my sister.
by.exampleZh: 我每天早上和我妹妹一起乘公交车上学。

cabbage.example: My mother cooks cabbage with some potatoes for dinner every Friday.
cabbage.exampleZh: 我妈妈每周五晚餐用一些土豆煮卷心菜。

cafe.example: We met at a small cafe near the station and talked for hours.
cafe.exampleZh: 我们在车站附近一家小咖啡馆见面，聊了几个小时。

cage.example: The bird was kept in a small cage near the window.
cage.exampleZh: 那只鸟被关在窗边的一个小笼子里。

cake.example: My mother made a chocolate cake for my birthday party last night.
cake.exampleZh: 我妈妈昨晚为我的生日聚会做了一个巧克力蛋糕。

call.example: I will call my mother tonight to tell her about the good news.
call.exampleZh: 我今晚会给妈妈打电话，告诉她这个好消息。

calm.example: She took a deep breath and stayed calm during the difficult test.
calm.exampleZh: 她在艰难的考试中深吸一口气并保持平静。

camera.example: I bought a new camera to take pictures on our trip.
camera.exampleZh: 我买了一台新相机，用来在我们的旅行中拍照。

camp.example: We will camp near the lake and cook food with our friends.
camp.exampleZh: 我们将在湖边露营，和朋友们一起做饭。

can.example: I can open this can of soup for you.

canada.example: My cousin moved to Canada last year to study at a big university.
canada.exampleZh: 我的表亲去年搬到加拿大去一所大型大学学习。

canadian.example: My Canadian friend likes to play hockey with us every weekend.
canadian.exampleZh: 我的加拿大朋友喜欢每个周末和我们一起打冰球。

candle.example: She lit a candle and put it on the kitchen table.
candle.exampleZh: 她点燃了一根蜡烛，把它放在厨房桌子上。

candy.example: The little boy ate too much candy and felt sick.
candy.exampleZh: 那个小男孩吃了太多糖果，感到不舒服。

canteen.example: We usually eat lunch in the school canteen with our friends every day.
canteen.exampleZh: 我们通常每天和朋友们在学校食堂吃午饭。

capital.example: Beijing is the capital of China and a very large city.
capital.exampleZh: 北京是中国的首都，也是一座非常大的城市。

captain.example: The captain told his team to stay calm and keep trying.
captain.exampleZh: 队长告诉他的队员保持冷静并继续努力。

car.example: My father drives his new car to work every morning.
car.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上开他的新车去上班。

card.example: I wrote a nice message on a birthday card for my best friend.
card.exampleZh: 我在一张生日贺卡上给我最好的朋友写了一段美好的话。

care.example: Her care for the sick children moved everyone deeply.
care.exampleZh: 她对生病孩子们的关心深深打动了每个人。

careful.example: Please be careful when you cross the busy street.
careful.exampleZh: 过繁忙的街道时请小心。

careless.example: He made a careless mistake and lost his keys again.
careless.exampleZh: 他犯了一个粗心的错误，又把钥匙弄丢了。

carry.example: She will carry the heavy box to the car for her friend.
carry.exampleZh: 她会帮朋友把那个重箱子搬到车上。

cartoon.example: My little sister watches a funny cartoon every morning before she goes to school.
cartoon.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天早上上学前都会看一部有趣的动画片。

case.example: This is a very easy case for the new doctor to solve.
case.exampleZh: 这对新医生来说是一个很容易处理的病例。

cash.example: I paid for the groceries in cash at the store yesterday.
cash.exampleZh: 我昨天在商店用现金付了食品杂货的钱。

castle.example: The old castle stands on a hill near the river.
castle.exampleZh: 那座古老的城堡矗立在河边的山上。

cat.example: The cat is sleeping on the warm sofa in the living room.
cat.exampleZh: 这只猫正在客厅里温暖的沙发上睡觉。

catch.example: I ran fast to catch the bus before it left the station.
catch.exampleZh: 我跑得很快，赶在公交车离站前追上了它。

cattle.example: The farmer keeps cattle on his small farm and feeds them every morning.
cattle.exampleZh: 农夫在他的小农场养牛，每天早上喂它们。

cause.example: Smoking can cause serious health problems for many people.
cause.exampleZh: 吸烟会给许多人带来严重的健康问题。

celebrate.example: We will celebrate her birthday with a small party at home.
celebrate.exampleZh: 我们将在家里举办一个小派对庆祝她的生日。

celebration.example: The whole town came together for a big celebration last night.
celebration.exampleZh: 昨晚全镇人聚在一起参加了一场盛大的庆祝活动。

cent.example: I found a shiny cent on the sidewalk near my school today.
cent.exampleZh: 今天我在学校附近的人行道上发现了一枚闪亮的一分硬币。

center.example: The new library is in the center of our small town.
center.exampleZh: 新图书馆在我们小镇的中心。

central.example: The central park is a quiet place for families on weekends.
central.exampleZh: 中央公园是周末家庭休闲的安静场所。

century.example: The old church was built in the nineteenth century and still stands today.
century.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂建于十九世纪，至今仍然矗立。

certain.example: I am certain that this is the right answer for you.
certain.exampleZh: 我确定这是适合你的正确答案。

certainly.example: She will certainly come to the party with her best friend.
certainly.exampleZh: 她肯定会和她最好的朋友一起来参加聚会。

chair.example: He put his bag on the chair and sat down.
chair.exampleZh: 他把包放在椅子上然后坐下了。

chalk.example: The teacher wrote the new words on the board with a piece of chalk.
chalk.exampleZh: 老师用一支粉笔把新单词写在了黑板上。

chance.example: There is a good chance that it will rain tomorrow afternoon.
chance.exampleZh: 明天下午很有可能会下雨。

change.example: I want to change my old phone for a new one today.
change.exampleZh: 我今天想用旧手机换一部新的。

channel.example: This TV channel shows many old movies every night.
channel.exampleZh: 这个电视频道每晚播放许多老电影。

chapter.example: I read the first chapter of this book last night.
chapter.exampleZh: 我昨晚读了这本书的第一章。

cheap.example: This coat is cheap, but it still looks good and keeps me warm.
cheap.exampleZh: 这件外套很便宜，但看起来仍然不错，还能让我保暖。

cheat.example: He tried to cheat on the test and got caught.
cheat.exampleZh: 他考试时试图作弊，被抓住了。

check.example: Please check your answers carefully before you hand in the test.
check.exampleZh: 请在交卷前仔细检查你的答案。

cheer.example: The fans cheer loudly when their team scores a goal.
cheer.exampleZh: 当他们的球队进球时，球迷们大声欢呼。

cheese.example: I like to put some cheese on my bread for lunch.
cheese.exampleZh: 我午饭喜欢在面包上放些奶酪。

chemistry.example: I study chemistry because I want to understand how things change.
chemistry.exampleZh: 我学习化学，因为我想了解事物是如何变化的。

chess.example: My father taught me how to play chess when I was young.
chess.exampleZh: 我小时候父亲教我下国际象棋。

chicken.example: My grandmother cooks chicken with rice and vegetables for our family every Sunday.
chicken.exampleZh: 我奶奶每个星期天为家人做鸡肉配米饭和蔬菜。

child.example: The child is playing with a small red ball in the garden.
child.exampleZh: 那个小孩正在花园里玩一个红色的小球。

chimney.example: Smoke from the old chimney rose slowly into the cold winter sky.
chimney.exampleZh: 烟从旧烟囱里慢慢升入寒冷的冬日天空。

china.example: I want to visit China next year because its history and food interest me.
china.exampleZh: 我想明年去中国，因为它的历史和美食让我感兴趣。

chinese.example: My Chinese friend teaches me how to cook simple food at home.
chinese.exampleZh: 我的中国朋友教我在家如何做简单的饭菜。

chocolate.example: She bought a box of chocolate for her best friend.
chocolate.exampleZh: 她给最好的朋友买了一盒巧克力。

choice.example: You have a choice between tea and coffee this morning.
choice.exampleZh: 今天早上你可以选择茶或咖啡。

choose.example: You can choose any book you like from this small shelf.
choose.exampleZh: 你可以从这个小书架上选择任何你喜欢的书。

chopsticks.example: I use chopsticks when I eat noodles at my favorite restaurant.
chopsticks.exampleZh: 我在最喜欢的餐厅吃面条时用筷子。

christmas.example: My family always spends Christmas together at my grandparents' house in the countryside.
christmas.exampleZh: 我们一家人总是在乡下爷爷奶奶家一起过圣诞节。

church.example: My family goes to the old church every Sunday morning.
church.exampleZh: 我家人每个星期天早上都去那座老教堂。

cinema.example: We went to the cinema last night to watch a new movie.
cinema.exampleZh: 我们昨晚去电影院看了一部新电影。

circle.example: The children sat in a circle and sang a happy song together.
circle.exampleZh: 孩子们围坐成一个圆圈，一起唱了一首快乐的歌。

city.example: I moved to a big city last year to find a new job.
city.exampleZh: 去年我搬到大城市去找一份新工作。

class.example: Our English class starts at nine every morning in a bright classroom.
class.exampleZh: 我们的英语课每天早上九点在一间明亮的教室里开始。

classmate.example: My classmate sits next to me and helps me with math.
classmate.exampleZh: 我的同班同学坐在我旁边，还帮我学数学。

classroom.example: Our teacher asked us to keep the classroom clean and quiet every day.
classroom.exampleZh: 我们老师要求我们每天保持教室干净安静。

clean.example: Please clean your room before you go out to play with your friends.
clean.exampleZh: 请在你和朋友出去玩之前打扫你的房间。

clear.example: The sky is clear today, so we can see the mountains far away.
clear.exampleZh: 今天天空晴朗，所以我们可以看到远处的山。

clever.example: The clever boy solved the easy puzzle before everyone else did.
clever.exampleZh: 那个聪明的男孩在其他人之前解开了这个简单的谜题。

climb.example: The children climb the tall tree in the garden.
climb.exampleZh: 孩子们在花园里爬那棵大树。

clinic.example: The new clinic is near my house and opens early every morning.
clinic.exampleZh: 新诊所就在我家附近，每天早上很早就开门。

clock.example: I look at the clock every morning before I go to work.
clock.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都会看一眼时钟。

close.example: Please close the door quietly because the baby is sleeping in the next room.
close.exampleZh: 请轻轻关上门，因为宝宝在隔壁房间睡觉。

clothes.example: I wash my clothes every Saturday morning before I go to the market.
clothes.exampleZh: 我每周六早上都会在去市场前洗衣服。

cloud.example: A dark cloud moved slowly across the sky before the rain came.
cloud.exampleZh: 一片乌云在雨来临前缓缓掠过天空。

cloudy.example: The sky is cloudy today, so we may get some rain later.
cloudy.exampleZh: 今天天空多云，所以稍后可能会下雨。

club.example: I joined the school chess club because I wanted to make new friends.
club.exampleZh: 我加入了学校国际象棋俱乐部，因为我想结交新朋友。

coach.example: Our coach told us to run faster and never give up.
coach.exampleZh: 我们的教练告诉我们要跑得更快，永不放弃。

coal.example: The old train burns coal to make power for the town.
coal.exampleZh: 那列旧火车烧煤为小镇发电。

coast.example: We walked along the coast and watched the waves hit the rocks.
coast.exampleZh: 我们沿着海岸散步，看着海浪拍打岩石。

coat.example: She put on a warm coat before she went outside to play.
coat.exampleZh: 她穿上一件暖和的外套，然后到外面去玩。

coffee.example: I drink a cup of coffee every morning before I go to work.
coffee.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前喝一杯咖啡。

coin.example: He found a coin on the street and put it in his pocket.
coin.exampleZh: 他在街上发现了一枚硬币，并把它放进了口袋。

coke.example: She drank a cold glass of coke after the long walk.
coke.exampleZh: 走了很长的路后，她喝了一杯冰可乐。

cold.example: It is very cold outside, so please wear a warm coat today.
cold.exampleZh: 外面很冷，所以今天请穿件暖和的外套。

collar.example: The dog wore a red collar around its neck all day.
collar.exampleZh: 那只狗整天脖子上戴着一条红色颈圈。

collect.example: I collect old coins from many countries and keep them in a small box.
collect.exampleZh: 我收集来自许多国家的旧硬币，并把它们放在一个小盒子里。

college.example: My sister studies at a college near our home and likes it very much.
college.exampleZh: 我姐姐在我们家附近的一所学院学习，她非常喜欢那里。

colour.example: I like the colour blue because it makes me feel calm and happy.
colour.exampleZh: 我喜欢蓝色，因为它让我感到平静和快乐。

comb.example: She used a clean comb to tidy her hair before school.
comb.exampleZh: 她在上学前用一把干净的梳子整理头发。

comfort.example: A warm blanket can bring great comfort on a cold night.
comfort.exampleZh: 在寒冷的夜晚，一条温暖的毯子能带来极大的舒适。

comfortable.example: This chair is very comfortable to sit in after a long day.
comfortable.exampleZh: 在漫长的一天后，坐在这把椅子上非常舒服。

common.example: It is common for people to wait in line at busy stores.
common.exampleZh: 在繁忙的商店里，人们排队等候是很常见的。

communicate.example: We use simple words to communicate with our friends every day.
communicate.exampleZh: 我们每天用简单的词语与朋友交流。

communication.example: Good communication between parents and children can solve many problems at home.
communication.exampleZh: 父母和孩子之间良好的沟通可以解决家里的许多问题。

company.example: My father works for a small company in our city.
company.exampleZh: 我父亲在我们城市的一家小公司工作。

compare.example: Please compare these two pictures and tell me what you see.
compare.exampleZh: 请比较这两张图片，告诉我你看到了什么。

competition.example: She won first place in the singing competition at our school last week.
competition.exampleZh: 她上周在我们学校的歌唱比赛中获得了第一名。

complain.example: Some customers often complain about the slow service at this small restaurant.
complain.exampleZh: 一些顾客经常抱怨这家小餐厅服务慢。

complete.example: Please complete the form and return it to the office by Friday.
complete.exampleZh: 请在周五前填好表格并交回办公室。

composition.example: She wrote a short composition about her summer holiday for the class.
composition.exampleZh: 她为班级写了一篇关于暑假的短文。

computer.example: I use my computer every day to check email and do my homework.
computer.exampleZh: 我每天用电脑查邮件和做作业。

concert.example: We went to a concert last night and the music was great.
concert.exampleZh: 我们昨晚去了一场音乐会，音乐很棒。

condition.example: The old car is still in good condition after many years.
condition.exampleZh: 这辆旧车多年后仍然状况良好。

conversation.example: We had a long conversation about our plans for next summer.
conversation.exampleZh: 我们就明年夏天的计划进行了一次长时间的交谈。

cook.example: My mother will cook a big dinner for our family tonight.
cook.exampleZh: 我妈妈今晚会为我们家做一顿丰盛的晚餐。

cookie.example: My little sister ate a chocolate cookie after dinner last night.
cookie.exampleZh: 我妹妹昨晚晚饭后吃了一块巧克力曲奇。

cool.example: The evening air is cool and pleasant after a long hot day.
cool.exampleZh: 漫长炎热的一天过后，傍晚的空气凉爽宜人。

copy.example: Please make a copy of this page and give it to me.
copy.exampleZh: 请把这一页复印一份，然后交给我。

corn.example: My family grows corn on the farm every summer and sells it at the local market.
corn.exampleZh: 我家每年夏天在农场种玉米，并在当地市场出售。

corner.example: The cat is sleeping in the corner of the room.
corner.exampleZh: 猫正在房间的角落里睡觉。

correct.example: Please correct your mistakes before you hand in the final test paper.
correct.exampleZh: 请在交最终试卷前改正你的错误。

cost.example: The new phone will cost too much for most students this year.
cost.exampleZh: 这台新手机今年对大多数学生来说会花费太高。

cotton.example: My mother bought a soft cotton shirt for me last week.
cotton.exampleZh: 我妈妈上周给我买了一件柔软的棉布衬衫。

cough.example: He has a bad cough and needs to see a doctor.
cough.exampleZh: 他咳得很厉害，需要去看医生。

could.example: She could not come to the party because she was very busy.
could.exampleZh: 她因为非常忙，所以没能来参加聚会。

count.example: Please count the books on the desk and tell me the number.
count.exampleZh: 请数一下桌子上的书，告诉我有多少本。

country.example: Many people in this country live and work in small villages.
country.exampleZh: 这个国家的许多人在小村庄里生活和工作。

countryside.example: My grandparents live in the countryside and they grow vegetables every year.
countryside.exampleZh: 我的祖父母住在乡下，他们每年种蔬菜。

county.example: Our county has a new library and a large public park.
county.exampleZh: 我们县有一座新图书馆和一个大型公园。

couple.example: A couple of students stayed after class to ask the teacher some questions.
couple.exampleZh: 几个学生下课后留下来问老师一些问题。

course.example: This cooking course teaches you how to make simple meals at home.
course.exampleZh: 这门烹饪课程教你如何在家做简单的饭菜。

court.example: The court will decide the case tomorrow morning after hearing both sides.
court.exampleZh: 法庭将在听取双方陈述后于明天上午对此案作出裁决。

cousin.example: My cousin comes to visit us every summer and we play together.
cousin.exampleZh: 我的表弟每年夏天都来看我们，我们一起玩。

cover.example: Please cover the food with a clean cloth before you leave.
cover.exampleZh: 离开前请用一块干净的布把食物盖上。

cow.example: The farmer milks his brown cow every morning before the sun rises.
cow.exampleZh: 农夫每天早晨在太阳升起前给棕色奶牛挤奶。

crayon.example: The little boy drew a bright sun with a red crayon on paper.
crayon.exampleZh: 小男孩用红色蜡笔在纸上画了一个明亮的太阳。

crazy.example: My brother is crazy about football and watches every match on TV.
crazy.exampleZh: 我弟弟对足球很着迷，电视上每场比赛都看。

cream.example: She likes to put cream in her coffee every morning before work.
cream.exampleZh: 她喜欢每天早上上班前在咖啡里加奶油。

create.example: Small changes in our daily habits can create big results over time.
create.exampleZh: 日常习惯中的小改变随着时间推移能创造巨大成果。

credit.example: She bought the car on credit and paid it off later.
credit.exampleZh: 她赊购了这辆车，后来还清了款项。

cross.example: Please cross the street carefully when the light is green.
cross.exampleZh: 绿灯时请小心穿过马路。

crossing.example: Please use the crossing when you walk across this busy street.
crossing.exampleZh: 过这条繁忙的街道时，请走人行横道。

crowd.example: A large crowd gathered in the square to watch the street performance.
crowd.exampleZh: 一大群人聚集在广场上观看街头表演。

cruel.example: It is cruel to leave a small dog alone all day.
cruel.exampleZh: 把一只小狗整天独自留在家里是很残忍的。

cry.example: The baby began to cry when she dropped her toy on the floor.
cry.exampleZh: 宝宝把玩具掉在地上时开始哭了起来。

culture.example: Learning about other cultures helps us understand people from different countries.
culture.exampleZh: 了解其他文化有助于我们理解来自不同国家的人。

cup.example: She poured hot tea into a cup and gave it to me.
cup.exampleZh: 她把热茶倒进杯子里，然后递给了我。

cupboard.example: The clean cups are in the kitchen cupboard next to the sink.
cupboard.exampleZh: 干净的杯子在水槽旁边的厨房橱柜里。

cure.example: Doctors hope this new medicine will cure many sick people soon.
cure.exampleZh: 医生们希望这种新药很快能治愈许多病人。

curious.example: The curious little boy asked many questions about the stars.
curious.exampleZh: 那个好奇的小男孩问了许多关于星星的问题。

curtain.example: She opened the curtain to let the morning light into the room.
curtain.exampleZh: 她拉开窗帘，让晨光进入房间。

custom.example: It is a local custom to eat dumplings during the Spring Festival.
custom.exampleZh: 春节期间吃饺子是当地的一种习俗。

customer.example: The customer asked the shop owner for a small discount today.
customer.exampleZh: 这位顾客今天向店主请求了一点小折扣。

cut.example: Please cut the cake into small pieces for the children.
cut.exampleZh: 请把蛋糕切成小块给孩子们。

cute.example: The little girl has a cute puppy and she loves to play with it.
cute.exampleZh: 这个小女孩有一只可爱的小狗，她喜欢和它玩。

daily.example: I read the news daily to stay informed about the world.
daily.exampleZh: 我每天读新闻以了解世界。

dance.example: We like to dance together at the party every Friday night.
dance.exampleZh: 我们喜欢每周五晚上在聚会上一起跳舞。

danger.example: The sign warns people of danger near the deep river.
danger.exampleZh: 这个标牌提醒人们深河附近有危险。

dangerous.example: Driving too fast on wet roads is very dangerous for everyone.
dangerous.exampleZh: 在湿滑的道路上开得太快对每个人都非常危险。

dare.example: I dare you to jump into the cold water with me.
dare.exampleZh: 我挑战你和我一起跳进冷水里。

dark.example: The room was dark, so I turned on a small light.
dark.exampleZh: 房间很暗，所以我打开了一盏小灯。

date.example: We set the date for our next meeting on Monday.
date.exampleZh: 我们把下次会议的日期定在星期一。

daughter.example: My daughter likes to read books with me every evening.
daughter.exampleZh: 我女儿喜欢每天晚上和我一起读书。

day.example: I go for a walk every day after work.
day.exampleZh: 我每天下班后都去散步。

dead.example: The old tree in our garden has been dead for many years now.
dead.exampleZh: 我们花园里的那棵老树已经死了很多年了。

deaf.example: My grandfather is deaf in one ear, but he still hears loud sounds.
deaf.exampleZh: 我爷爷一只耳朵聋了，但他仍能听见很大的声音。

deal.example: I made a good deal with my friend at the market today.
deal.exampleZh: 我今天在市场上和朋友做了一笔好交易。

dear.example: My dear friend gave me a very nice book yesterday.
dear.exampleZh: 我亲爱的朋友昨天给了我一本非常好的书。

death.example: The old man was not afraid of death after a long happy life.
death.exampleZh: 那位老人在度过漫长幸福的一生后不再害怕死亡。

december.example: My birthday is in December, and we always have a small party at home.
december.exampleZh: 我的生日在十二月，我们总是在家里办一个小聚会。

decide.example: We need to decide where to go for dinner tonight.
decide.exampleZh: 我们需要决定今晚去哪里吃晚饭。

decision.example: She made a quick decision and left the room without saying goodbye.
decision.exampleZh: 她迅速做了决定，没说再见就离开了房间。

deep.example: The lake is very deep, so we cannot see the bottom.
deep.exampleZh: 这个湖很深，所以我们看不到底。

deer.example: We saw a deer standing quietly near the edge of the forest.
deer.exampleZh: 我们看到一只鹿静静地站在森林边缘附近。

degree.example: She got a degree in history after four years of study.
degree.exampleZh: 她学习四年后获得了历史学学位。

delicious.example: The soup smells delicious, and everyone wants to eat it.
delicious.exampleZh: 这汤闻起来很香，大家都想吃。

delight.example: The children shouted with delight when they saw the big gift.
delight.exampleZh: 孩子们看到大礼物时高兴地欢呼起来。

deliver.example: The mail carrier will deliver the package to your house tomorrow.
deliver.exampleZh: 邮递员明天会把包裹送到你家。

demand.example: The workers demand better pay and safer working conditions.
demand.exampleZh: 工人们要求更好的薪酬和更安全的工作条件。

dentist.example: I went to the dentist yesterday because my tooth hurt a lot.
dentist.exampleZh: 我昨天去看牙医了，因为我的牙很疼。

department.example: She works in the sales department of a small company in our city.
department.exampleZh: 她在我们城市一家小公司的销售部工作。

depend.example: Many young people depend on their parents for help with daily problems.
depend.exampleZh: 许多年轻人在日常问题上依靠父母的帮助。

describe.example: Please describe the man you saw near the school this morning.
describe.exampleZh: 请描述你今天早上在学校附近看到的那个男人。

description.example: The police asked me for a description of the missing car.
description.exampleZh: 警方要求我描述那辆失踪的汽车。

desert.example: The hot desert is dry and has very little water.
desert.exampleZh: 炎热的沙漠很干燥，几乎没有水。

design.example: She will design a simple poster for the school event next week.
design.exampleZh: 她将为下周的学校活动设计一张简单的海报。

desk.example: I do my homework at my desk every evening after dinner.
desk.exampleZh: 我每天晚饭后都在书桌旁做作业。

develop.example: We plan to develop a new app for young students this year.
develop.exampleZh: 我们计划今年为年轻学生开发一款新应用。

development.example: The development of new technology can help small towns grow.
development.exampleZh: 新技术的发展可以帮助小城镇成长。

dialogue.example: We had a short dialogue about the new project after lunch today.
dialogue.exampleZh: 今天午饭后，我们就新项目进行了简短的对话。

diary.example: I write in my diary every night before I go to sleep.
diary.exampleZh: 我每天晚上睡觉前都会在日记里写点东西。

dictionary.example: I use a dictionary to look up new words every day.
dictionary.exampleZh: 我每天用词典查新单词。

die.example: Many people fear that they will die alone in a cold room.
die.exampleZh: 许多人害怕自己会在一个寒冷的房间里孤独地死去。

difference.example: There is a big difference between the two plans.
difference.exampleZh: 这两个计划之间有很大的差别。

different.example: People from different countries can still be good friends.
different.exampleZh: 来自不同国家的人仍然可以成为好朋友。

difficult.example: This math problem is very difficult for most students in our class.
difficult.exampleZh: 这道数学题对我们班大多数学生来说很难。

difficulty.example: She had difficulty finding the right words during the meeting.
difficulty.exampleZh: 她在会议上很难找到合适的措辞。

dig.example: The dog likes to dig holes in the soft garden soil.
dig.exampleZh: 那只狗喜欢在松软的花园泥土里挖洞。

dinner.example: We had a delicious dinner with our friends at a small restaurant last night.
dinner.exampleZh: 昨晚我们和朋友们在一家小餐馆吃了一顿美味的晚餐。

direct.example: The teacher will direct the students to the right room.
direct.exampleZh: 老师会指引学生去正确的房间。

direction.example: Please follow the directions on the map to find the old library.
direction.exampleZh: 请按照地图上的指示找到那座旧图书馆。

director.example: The director asked the actors to come to the studio early today.
director.exampleZh: 导演让演员们今天早点来摄影棚。

dirt.example: The children came home with dirt on their hands and faces.
dirt.exampleZh: 孩子们回到家时手上和脸上都是泥土。

dirty.example: His dirty shoes made the floor very messy after he walked through the room.
dirty.exampleZh: 他脏兮兮的鞋子在他穿过房间后把地板弄得很脏。

discover.example: We hope to discover a new way to solve this problem.
discover.exampleZh: 我们希望找到一种新方法来解决这个问题。

discovery.example: The scientist made an important discovery about the human brain last year.
discovery.exampleZh: 这位科学家去年对人类大脑做出了重要发现。

discuss.example: We often discuss our plans before we make any big decisions.
discuss.exampleZh: 我们经常在做任何重大决定之前讨论我们的计划。

discussion.example: We had a long discussion about our plans for the summer.
discussion.exampleZh: 我们就夏天的计划进行了长时间的讨论。

disease.example: The disease spread quickly through the village and made many people sick.
disease.exampleZh: 这种疾病迅速蔓延到整个村庄，使许多人病倒了。

dish.example: She put the clean dishes on the table after dinner.
dish.exampleZh: 晚饭后她把干净的盘子放在桌子上。

divide.example: The teacher will divide the class into four small groups for the game.
divide.exampleZh: 老师会把班级分成四个小组来做游戏。

do.example: I do my homework every day after school with my sister.
do.exampleZh: 我每天放学后和姐姐一起做作业。

doctor.example: I went to see the doctor because I had a bad cold.
doctor.exampleZh: 我去看医生，因为我得了重感冒。

dog.example: My dog likes to run in the park every morning.
dog.exampleZh: 我的狗喜欢每天早上在公园里跑。

doll.example: The little girl hugged her doll and smiled at her mother.
doll.exampleZh: 小女孩抱着她的洋娃娃，对妈妈笑了。

dollar.example: I only have one dollar in my pocket today.
dollar.exampleZh: 我今天口袋里只有一美元。

door.example: Please close the door when you leave the room.
door.exampleZh: 离开房间时请把门关上。

double.example: I ordered a double coffee because I had a long day at work.
double.exampleZh: 我点了一杯双份咖啡，因为我在工作上度过了漫长的一天。

doubt.example: I still have some doubt about whether he will come today.
doubt.exampleZh: 我对他今天是否会来仍有一些怀疑。

down.example: The cat ran down the hill and then stopped.
down.exampleZh: 猫跑下山丘，然后停了下来。

download.example: You can download the new app for free on your phone.
download.exampleZh: 你可以在手机上免费下载这个新应用。

downstairs.example: I left my bag downstairs and went to the kitchen to get some water.
downstairs.exampleZh: 我把包落在楼下，然后去厨房拿了点水。

dozen.example: I bought a dozen eggs at the store this morning.
dozen.exampleZh: 今天早上我在商店买了一打鸡蛋。

draw.example: She likes to draw pictures of animals in her notebook every day.
draw.exampleZh: 她喜欢每天在笔记本上画动物。

dream.example: She has a dream of becoming a doctor and helping many people.
dream.exampleZh: 她有一个成为医生并帮助许多人的梦想。

dress.example: She wears a beautiful blue dress to the party every summer.
dress.exampleZh: 她每年夏天都穿一条漂亮的蓝色连衣裙去参加聚会。

drink.example: I drink a glass of water every morning before I go to work.
drink.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前喝一杯水。

drive.example: My father drives me to school every morning before he goes to work.
drive.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上上班前开车送我去学校。

driver.example: The driver stopped the bus and helped the old woman get off.
driver.exampleZh: 司机停下公交车，帮助那位老妇人下车。

drop.example: I saw a drop of rain fall on the green leaf.
drop.exampleZh: 我看到一滴雨落在绿叶上。

drought.example: The long drought dried up the river and killed many crops.
drought.exampleZh: 长期的干旱使河流干涸，并导致许多庄稼枯死。

drown.example: The boy almost drowned in the river, but a man saved him.
drown.exampleZh: 那个男孩在河里差点淹死，但一个男人救了他。

drug.example: The doctor gave him a drug to help with the pain.
drug.exampleZh: 医生给了他一种药来帮助缓解疼痛。

drum.example: She played the drum in the school band every Friday afternoon.
drum.exampleZh: 她每周五下午在学校乐队里打鼓。

dry.example: Please dry your hands with this clean towel before you eat dinner.
dry.exampleZh: 请在吃晚饭前用这条干净毛巾擦干你的手。

duck.example: There are many ducks swimming in the pond near our house.
duck.exampleZh: 我们家附近的池塘里有很多鸭子在游泳。

dumpling.example: My mother makes dumplings with pork and cabbage every Sunday.
dumpling.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期天都用猪肉和白菜包饺子。

during.example: I read many books during the summer holiday last year.
during.exampleZh: 去年暑假期间我读了很多书。

duty.example: It is your duty to help your friends when they need you.
duty.exampleZh: 当朋友需要你时，帮助他们就是你的责任。

dvd.example: I found an old DVD in the box under my bed last night.
dvd.exampleZh: 昨晚我在床下的盒子里找到了一张旧DVD。

each.example: Each student in our class has a small notebook for new words.
each.exampleZh: 我们班每个学生都有一个记新单词的小本子。

ear.example: She covered her ears because the loud music was too much for her.
ear.exampleZh: 她捂住耳朵，因为那音乐太吵了。

early.example: I woke up early this morning to catch the first bus.
early.exampleZh: 我今天早上很早起床去赶第一班公交车。

earth.example: The earth is our home, and we must take care of it.
earth.exampleZh: 地球是我们的家园，我们必须爱护它。

earthquake.example: The strong earthquake shook the city and many people ran outside.
earthquake.exampleZh: 强烈的地震震动了城市，许多人跑到外面。

east.example: The sun rises in the east and lights up the whole sky.
