front.exampleZh: 我前面那辆车在红灯前突然停了下来。

fruit.example: Eating fresh fruit every day is a good habit for your health.
fruit.exampleZh: 每天吃新鲜水果对你的健康是一个好习惯。

full.example: The glass is full of water, so please do not spill it.
full.exampleZh: 杯子装满了水，所以请不要把它弄洒。

fun.example: We had a lot of fun at the party last night.
fun.exampleZh: 我们昨晚在聚会上玩得很开心。

function.example: The main function of this machine is to clean the floor quickly.
function.exampleZh: 这台机器的主要功能是快速清洁地板。

funny.example: It was funny to see my dog sleep in the small box.
funny.exampleZh: 看到我的狗睡在那个小盒子里很有趣。

fur.example: The soft fur of the cat feels warm on cold nights.
fur.exampleZh: 猫柔软的毛在寒冷的夜晚摸起来很温暖。

furniture.example: We bought new furniture for the living room last week.
furniture.exampleZh: 我们上周为客厅买了新家具。

future.example: I hope to have a good job in the future.
future.exampleZh: 我希望将来能有一份好工作。

game.example: The children played a fun game in the park after school.
game.exampleZh: 孩子们放学后在公园里玩了一个有趣的游戏。

garage.example: I parked my car in the garage before the heavy rain started.
garage.exampleZh: 我在大雨开始前把车停进了车库。

garden.example: My grandmother grows many beautiful flowers in her small garden every spring.
garden.exampleZh: 我奶奶每年春天在她的小花园里种许多美丽的花。

gas.example: The gas from the stove smells bad, so please open the window.
gas.exampleZh: 炉子里的煤气很难闻，请打开窗户。

gate.example: Please wait for me near the main gate after school today.
gate.exampleZh: 今天放学后请在大门附近等我。

gather.example: People gather in the park every morning to talk and exercise.
gather.exampleZh: 人们每天早上聚集在公园里聊天和锻炼。

general.example: The general idea is simple, and most people can understand it easily.
general.exampleZh: 总体想法很简单，大多数人都能轻松理解。

gentleman.example: The old gentleman opened the door and smiled kindly at the young girl.
gentleman.exampleZh: 那位老绅士打开门，对那个小女孩和蔼地笑了笑。

geography.example: I study geography because I want to understand the world and its people.
geography.exampleZh: 我学习地理是因为我想了解世界和它的人民。

german.example: My German friend speaks English very well and loves Chinese food.
german.exampleZh: 我的德国朋友英语说得很好，而且喜欢中国菜。

germany.example: I want to visit Germany next year with my family.
germany.exampleZh: 我想明年和家人一起去德国。

get.example: I need to get some milk and bread from the store today.
get.exampleZh: 我今天需要从商店买些牛奶和面包。

gift.example: She gave me a beautiful gift for my birthday last week.
gift.exampleZh: 上周她送了我一份漂亮的生日礼物。

giraffe.example: The giraffe has a very long neck and eats leaves from tall trees.
giraffe.exampleZh: 长颈鹿有很长的脖子，并且吃高树上的叶子。

girl.example: The little girl is playing with her friends in the park.
girl.exampleZh: 这个小女孩正在公园里和朋友们玩。

give.example: I will give my friend a book for his birthday.
give.exampleZh: 我会在我朋友生日时送他一本书。

glad.example: I am very glad to see you again today.
glad.exampleZh: 今天再次见到你，我很高兴。

glass.example: She poured a glass of water and put it on the table.
glass.exampleZh: 她倒了一杯水，把它放在桌子上。

glove.example: She wore a warm glove on her left hand in the cold snow.
glove.exampleZh: 她在寒冷的雪地里左手戴着一只温暖的手套。

glue.example: I used glue to fix the broken cup on the table.
glue.exampleZh: 我用胶水把桌上破了的杯子粘好了。

go.example: I have to go home now because my mother is waiting for me.
go.exampleZh: 我现在必须回家，因为我妈妈在等我。

goal.example: My main goal this year is to read more books at home.
goal.exampleZh: 我今年的主要目标是在家多读书。

god.example: Many people pray to God every morning before they start their day.
god.exampleZh: 许多人在开始一天的生活之前每天早上都向上帝祈祷。

gold.example: She wore a gold ring on her finger at the party.
gold.exampleZh: 她在聚会上手指上戴着一枚金戒指。

golden.example: The golden sun set slowly behind the quiet hills.
golden.exampleZh: 金色的太阳缓缓落在宁静的山丘后面。

good.example: She is a good teacher and all her students like her very much.
good.exampleZh: 她是一位好老师，她所有的学生都非常喜欢她。

goodbye.example: I waved goodbye to my friends and walked home after school.
goodbye.exampleZh: 我向朋友们挥手告别，放学后走回了家。

goods.example: The small store sells many goods at low prices every day.
goods.exampleZh: 这家小商店每天以低价出售许多商品。

goose.example: The goose swam across the pond with her young ones.
goose.exampleZh: 那只鹅带着小鹅游过了池塘。

government.example: The government has promised to build more roads and schools for the people.
government.exampleZh: 政府承诺为人民修建更多的道路和学校。

grade.example: My sister is in the fifth grade at a small local school.
grade.exampleZh: 我妹妹在一所小型本地学校读五年级。

grain.example: The farmer stores every grain of rice in a dry place.
grain.exampleZh: 农民把每一粒稻谷都存放在干燥的地方。

grandfather.example: My grandfather tells me a funny story every night before I go to bed.
grandfather.exampleZh: 我爷爷每天晚上在我睡觉前给我讲一个有趣的故事。

grandmother.example: My grandmother often tells me interesting stories about her childhood in the countryside.
grandmother.exampleZh: 我的祖母经常给我讲她在乡下的童年趣事。

grape.example: My mother bought some fresh grapes at the market this morning.
grape.exampleZh: 今天早上我妈妈在市场买了一些新鲜葡萄。

grass.example: The cows are eating grass in the green field.
grass.exampleZh: 奶牛们正在绿色的田野里吃草。

gray.example: The sky looks gray and it may rain soon.
gray.exampleZh: 天空看起来阴沉，可能很快要下雨。

great.example: She did a great job on the test and felt very happy.
great.exampleZh: 她在考试中表现得很棒，感到非常开心。

green.example: The green leaves look fresh after the rain this morning.
green.exampleZh: 今天早上下雨后，绿叶看起来很清新。

greet.example: Every morning I greet my neighbors with a smile and a friendly wave.
greet.exampleZh: 每天早上我都用微笑和友好的挥手向邻居们问好。

ground.example: The children played on the soft ground near the park.
ground.exampleZh: 孩子们在公园附近松软的地面上玩耍。

group.example: Our group meets in the library every Friday after school to study together.
group.exampleZh: 我们小组每周五放学后在图书馆一起学习。

grow.example: Children grow quickly when they eat well and get enough sleep.
grow.exampleZh: 孩子们吃得好、睡得足就会长得快。

guard.example: A guard stands at the gate and checks every person who comes in.
guard.exampleZh: 一名卫兵站在大门口，检查每一个进来的人。

guess.example: I guess we should leave now before it gets too dark outside.
guess.exampleZh: 我猜我们现在该走了，趁外面还没太黑。

guest.example: We have a guest staying with us for the weekend.
guest.exampleZh: 有一位客人周末住在我们家里。

guide.example: Our guide showed us the way to the old temple.
guide.exampleZh: 我们的向导给我们指了去古庙的路。

guitar.example: My brother plays the guitar every evening after he finishes his homework.
guitar.exampleZh: 我弟弟每天傍晚做完作业后弹吉他。

gun.example: The police officer put the gun safely in a locked box.
gun.exampleZh: 警察把枪安全地放进一个锁着的箱子里。

habit.example: Reading before bed is a good habit that helps me relax.
habit.exampleZh: 睡前阅读是一个帮助我放松的好习惯。

hair.example: She washes her hair every morning before school.
hair.exampleZh: 她每天早上上学前洗头发。

half.example: I ate half of the cake and saved the rest for later.
half.exampleZh: 我吃了一半蛋糕，把剩下的留到以后。

hall.example: The students waited in the hall before the meeting began.
hall.exampleZh: 学生们在会议开始前在门厅等候。

ham.example: I had a ham sandwich for lunch and it was very good.
ham.exampleZh: 我午餐吃了一个火腿三明治，味道很好。

hamburger.example: I bought a hamburger and some fries for lunch today.
hamburger.exampleZh: 我今天午餐买了一个汉堡包和一些薯条。

hand.example: Please hand me the book on the table before you leave.
hand.exampleZh: 请在你离开前把桌上的那本书递给我。

handbag.example: She put her phone and keys into a small black handbag before leaving.
handbag.exampleZh: 她离开前把手机和钥匙放进了一个黑色的小手提包里。

handsome.example: He is a handsome young man who often helps his neighbors.
handsome.exampleZh: 他是一个英俊的年轻人，经常帮助邻居。

hang.example: She likes to hang her coat on the hook by the door.
hang.exampleZh: 她喜欢把外套挂在门边的钩子上。

happen.example: Bad things can happen to anyone at any time.
happen.exampleZh: 坏事可能在任何时候发生在任何人身上。

happy.example: She is very happy to see her old friends at the party today.
happy.exampleZh: 她今天在聚会上见到老朋友非常高兴。

hard.example: This math problem is very hard, but I will not give up.
hard.exampleZh: 这道数学题很难，但我不会放弃。

hardly.example: I can hardly hear you because the music is too loud here.
hardly.exampleZh: 这里音乐太吵了，我几乎听不见你说话。

hat.example: He put on his hat and went out to play in the sun.
hat.exampleZh: 他戴上帽子，出去在阳光下玩耍。

hate.example: I hate waiting in long lines at the busy supermarket on weekends.
hate.exampleZh: 我讨厌周末在繁忙的超市里排长队等待。

have.example: I have two small cats and a big dog at home.
have.exampleZh: 我家里有两只小猫和一只大狗。

he.example: He works in a small shop and sells fresh fruit every day.
he.exampleZh: 他在一家小商店工作，每天卖新鲜水果。

head.example: The head of the company walked toward the door.
head.exampleZh: 公司的首领朝门口走去。

headache.example: A bad headache kept me in bed all day yesterday.
headache.exampleZh: 昨天剧烈的头痛让我整天卧床不起。

health.example: Eating good food and getting enough sleep can improve your health.
health.exampleZh: 吃好食物和充足睡眠可以改善你的健康。

healthy.example: Eating fresh vegetables every day helps you stay healthy and strong.
healthy.exampleZh: 每天吃新鲜蔬菜有助于你保持健康和强壮。

hear.example: I can hear the birds singing outside my window every morning.
hear.exampleZh: 我每天早上都能听到鸟儿在我窗外唱歌。

heart.example: She put her hand on her heart and smiled at the child.
heart.exampleZh: 她把手放在心口，对孩子笑了笑。

heat.example: The heat from the sun makes the room warm and comfortable.
heat.exampleZh: 太阳的热量使房间变得温暖舒适。

heaven.example: Many people believe that heaven is a beautiful place full of peace and love.
heaven.exampleZh: 许多人相信天堂是一个充满和平与爱的美丽地方。

heavy.example: The heavy box was too hard for me to carry upstairs.
heavy.exampleZh: 那个沉重的箱子太重了，我搬不上楼。

height.example: The height of the mountain surprised all the children in our small town.
height.exampleZh: 这座山的高度让我们小镇上的所有孩子都感到惊讶。

hello.example: When I answer the phone, I always say hello to the caller.
hello.exampleZh: 我接电话时总是对来电者说你好。

help.example: I asked my friend to help me move the heavy boxes to the new house.
help.exampleZh: 我请朋友帮我把重箱子搬到新房子。

helpful.example: My teacher is very helpful when I ask her questions.
helpful.exampleZh: 我问老师问题时，她非常乐于助人。

hen.example: The brown hen lays an egg every morning in the small coop.
hen.exampleZh: 那只棕色的母鸡每天早晨都在小笼子里下一个蛋。

her.example: I gave her the book because she needed it for school.
her.exampleZh: 我把那本书给了她，因为她上学需要它。

here.example: Please stay here and wait for me until I come back.

hero.example: The young hero saved the child from the river without any fear.
hero.exampleZh: 这位年轻的英雄毫无畏惧地把孩子从河里救了出来。

hide.example: She tried to hide the small key under the old blue cup.
hide.exampleZh: 她试着把那把小钥匙藏在一个旧的蓝色杯子下面。

high.example: The high mountain is hard to climb in winter.
high.exampleZh: 这座高山在冬天很难攀登。

hill.example: We walked up the small hill behind our house to watch the sunset.
hill.exampleZh: 我们爬上房子后面的小山去看日落。

him.example: I saw him at the park yesterday and we played football together.
him.exampleZh: 我昨天在公园看见他，我们一起踢足球。

himself.example: He hurt himself while playing football with his friends yesterday.
himself.exampleZh: 他昨天和朋友们踢足球时伤到了自己。

his.example: Tom forgot his umbrella at school, so he walked home in the rain.
his.exampleZh: 汤姆把雨伞忘在学校了，所以他冒雨走回家。

history.example: She loves history and often reads books about ancient China and its people.
history.exampleZh: 她热爱历史，经常阅读关于古代中国及其人民的书籍。

hit.example: The ball hit the window and broke the glass in the room.
hit.exampleZh: 球击中了窗户，打碎了房间里的玻璃。

hobby.example: Reading books is my favorite hobby because it helps me relax after work.
hobby.exampleZh: 读书是我最喜欢的业余爱好，因为它能帮助我在工作后放松。

hold.example: Please hold this bag for me while I open the door.
hold.exampleZh: 请帮我拿着这个包，我去开门。

hole.example: There is a small hole in the old wooden fence.
hole.exampleZh: 旧木栅栏上有一个小洞。

holiday.example: We plan to take a holiday next month after school ends.
holiday.exampleZh: 我们计划下个月学校放假后去度假。

home.example: I go home after school and my mother makes dinner for us.
home.exampleZh: 我放学后回家，妈妈为我们做晚饭。

homework.example: I always finish my homework before I watch TV with my family.
homework.exampleZh: 我总是在和家人看电视之前完成作业。

honest.example: She is an honest person and always tells the truth to her friends.
honest.exampleZh: 她是一个诚实的人，总是对朋友说真话。

honey.example: My mother puts honey in her tea every morning before work.
honey.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天早上上班前都会在茶里放蜂蜜。

hope.example: I hope you can come to my birthday party this weekend.
hope.exampleZh: 我希望你这个周末能来参加我的生日聚会。

horse.example: The farmer rides his horse across the field every morning before work.
horse.exampleZh: 农夫每天早上上班前骑马穿过田野。

hospital.example: My mother works at the hospital near our home every day.
hospital.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天在我们家附近的医院工作。

host.example: Our host made everyone feel welcome at the dinner party last night.
host.exampleZh: 昨晚我们的主人在晚宴上让每个人都感到受欢迎。

hot.example: The soup is very hot, so please wait a minute before you eat it.
hot.exampleZh: 这汤很烫，所以请等一分钟再吃。

hotel.example: We booked a small hotel near the train station for two nights.
hotel.exampleZh: 我们在火车站附近订了一家小旅馆，住两晚。

hour.example: I study English for one hour every evening after I finish my homework.
hour.exampleZh: 我每天晚上做完作业后学一小时英语。

house.example: They bought a small house near the park last year.
house.exampleZh: 他们去年在公园附近买了一栋小房子。

housework.example: I help my mother do the housework every Saturday morning.
housework.exampleZh: 我每周六早上帮妈妈做家务。

how.example: Can you show me how to use this new phone?
how.exampleZh: 你能教我怎样使用这部新手机吗？

however.example: The weather was cold; however, we still went for a short walk outside.
however.exampleZh: 天气很冷，然而我们仍然去外面短暂散步了。

hug.example: She gave her little brother a warm hug before he left for school.
hug.exampleZh: 弟弟去上学前，她给了他一个温暖的拥抱。

human.example: Every human should treat other people with kindness and respect.
human.exampleZh: 每个人都应该以善意和尊重对待他人。

hundred.example: There are more than a hundred students in this small school.
hundred.exampleZh: 这所小学校里有一百多名学生。

hungry.example: The hungry little boy ate all the bread on the table.
hungry.exampleZh: 那个饥饿的小男孩吃掉了桌上所有的面包。

hunt.example: They often hunt for food in the forest near their small village.
hunt.exampleZh: 他们经常在附近的小森林里寻找食物。

hurry.example: Please hurry or we will be late for the school bus.
hurry.exampleZh: 请快点，否则我们会赶不上校车。

hurt.example: Be careful with that knife, or you may hurt your hand.
hurt.exampleZh: 小心那把刀，否则你可能会伤到手。

husband.example: My husband cooks dinner for our family every evening after work.
husband.exampleZh: 我丈夫每天下班后为我们家做晚饭。

ice.example: The children put some ice in their drinks on a hot day.
ice.exampleZh: 孩子们在炎热的一天往饮料里放了一些冰。

idea.example: I have a good idea for our next class project.
idea.exampleZh: 我对我们下一个班级项目有一个好主意。

if.example: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home and watch a movie.
if.exampleZh: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里看电影。

ill.example: She felt ill after lunch, so she went home and rested all afternoon.
ill.exampleZh: 她午饭后感到不舒服，所以回家休息了一下午。

illness.example: His long illness kept him away from school for many weeks.
illness.exampleZh: 他的长期疾病使他好几周没能上学。

imagine.example: I can imagine how happy you will be when you see it.
imagine.exampleZh: 我能想象你看到它时会有多开心。

immediately.example: Please call me immediately when you get home after work today.
immediately.exampleZh: 你今天下班回家后请马上给我打电话。

importance.example: Teachers often tell students about the importance of good study habits.
importance.exampleZh: 老师常常告诉学生良好学习习惯的重要性。

important.example: It is important to eat well and get enough sleep every day.
important.exampleZh: 每天吃好并睡足很重要。

impossible.example: It is impossible to finish this work before the sun goes down.
impossible.exampleZh: 在太阳下山前完成这项工作是不可能的。

improve.example: We must improve our English if we want to get better jobs.
improve.exampleZh: 如果我们想找到更好的工作，就必须提高英语水平。

in.example: I will see you in the morning at the park.

inch.example: The table is six inches wide and two inches longer than mine.
inch.exampleZh: 这张桌子宽六英寸，比我的长两英寸。

include.example: The price includes breakfast and free Wi-Fi for all guests.
include.exampleZh: 这个价格包括所有客人的早餐和免费 Wi-Fi。

including.example: The price includes breakfast and dinner, including coffee and tea.
including.exampleZh: 价格包括早餐和晚餐，也包含咖啡和茶。

increase.example: The number of students will increase next year because the school is growing.
increase.exampleZh: 明年学生人数将会增加，因为学校在不断发展。

india.example: India is a large country in South Asia with many people.
india.exampleZh: 印度是南亚的一个大国，人口众多。

indian.example: I met an Indian student who cooked dinner for us yesterday.
indian.exampleZh: 我昨天遇到了一位为我们做晚饭的印度学生。

industry.example: The steel industry provides many jobs for local workers.
industry.exampleZh: 钢铁工业为当地工人提供了许多工作岗位。

information.example: She gave me some useful information about the new job.
information.exampleZh: 她给了我一些关于这份新工作的有用信息。

ink.example: I spilled some ink on my new white shirt this morning.
ink.exampleZh: 今天早上我把一些墨水洒在了我的新白衬衫上。

inside.example: The cat is sitting inside the warm house by the window.
inside.exampleZh: 那只猫正坐在窗边温暖的房子里。

instead.example: I wanted tea, but I drank water instead.
instead.exampleZh: 我本想喝茶，但我改喝水了。

instruction.example: Please read the instruction carefully before you use this new machine.
instruction.exampleZh: 请在使用这台新机器前仔细阅读说明。

interest.example: My brother has a strong interest in science and reads many books.
interest.exampleZh: 我哥哥对科学有浓厚的兴趣，并且读很多书。

interested.example: She is interested in learning new words every day after school.
interested.exampleZh: 她对每天放学后学习新单词很感兴趣。

interesting.example: This book is very interesting and I want to read it again.
interesting.exampleZh: 这本书很有趣，我想再读一遍。

international.example: The city will host an international sports event next summer for many young players.
international.exampleZh: 这座城市明年夏天将为许多年轻选手举办一场国际体育赛事。

internet.example: I use the internet every day to read news and talk with friends.
internet.exampleZh: 我每天用互联网看新闻和朋友聊天。

interview.example: She has an interview with a large company next Monday morning.
interview.exampleZh: 她下周一上午有一场大公司的面试。

into.example: She put the fresh flowers into a glass vase on the kitchen table.
into.exampleZh: 她把鲜花放进厨房桌子上的玻璃花瓶里。

introduce.example: Let me introduce you to my new friend from school.
introduce.exampleZh: 让我把你介绍给我在学校的新朋友。

invent.example: She tried to invent a simple game for her young students.
invent.exampleZh: 她试着为年幼的学生发明一个简单的游戏。

invite.example: I want to invite my friends to dinner at my house.
invite.exampleZh: 我想邀请朋友们来我家吃晚饭。

island.example: We took a small boat to the island and spent the afternoon there.
island.exampleZh: 我们坐小船去了那个岛，并在那里度过了一个下午。

it.example: It is very cold outside, so please wear a warm coat today.
it.exampleZh: 外面很冷，所以今天请穿一件暖和的外套。

its.example: The cat loves its soft bed and sleeps there every afternoon.
its.exampleZh: 这只猫喜欢它柔软的床，每天下午都在那里睡觉。

itself.example: The little cat washed itself by the warm fire after dinner.
itself.exampleZh: 小猫晚饭后在温暖的炉火旁自己洗了洗。

jacket.example: I put on my warm jacket before I went outside to play.
jacket.exampleZh: 我出门玩之前穿上了我温暖的夹克。

job.example: My new job is hard, but I like it very much.
job.exampleZh: 我的新工作很辛苦，但我非常喜欢它。

join.example: I will join the school music club this year because I love singing.
join.exampleZh: 我今年会加入学校音乐俱乐部，因为我喜欢唱歌。

joke.example: He told a funny joke and everyone laughed at the party.
joke.exampleZh: 他讲了一个有趣的笑话，聚会上大家都笑了。

journalist.example: The journalist asked my father several questions about the new road.
journalist.exampleZh: 那名记者问了我父亲几个关于新路的问题。

journey.example: The long journey home made everyone tired but happy.
journey.exampleZh: 漫长的回家旅程让每个人都疲惫但快乐。

joy.example: The children jumped with joy when they saw the snow falling outside.
joy.exampleZh: 孩子们看到外面下雪时，高兴得跳了起来。

judge.example: The judge listened carefully to both sides before making a final decision.
judge.exampleZh: 法官在做出最终裁决前仔细听取了双方的意见。

juice.example: I drink a glass of orange juice with my breakfast every morning.
juice.exampleZh: 我每天早上早餐时喝一杯橙汁。

july.example: My family always takes a long summer trip together in July.
july.exampleZh: 我们一家总是在七月一起进行长途夏季旅行。

jump.example: The children jump over the small fence and run across the grass.
jump.exampleZh: 孩子们跳过小栅栏，跑过草地。

june.example: We will go on a long trip in June with my family.
june.exampleZh: 六月我们将和家人一起去长途旅行。

just.example: I just finished my homework and I am ready to go out.
just.exampleZh: 我刚刚做完作业，准备出门。

justice.example: The judge promised to bring justice to the poor family.
justice.exampleZh: 法官承诺为这个贫困家庭伸张正义。

kangaroo.example: A kangaroo can jump very high and fast across the open field.
kangaroo.exampleZh: 袋鼠能又快又高地跳过开阔的田野。

keep.example: Please keep the door closed when you leave the room.
keep.exampleZh: 离开房间时请把门关好。

key.example: I lost my key and cannot open the front door.
key.exampleZh: 我丢了钥匙，打不开前门。

keyboard.example: I use my keyboard every day to type emails and school papers.
keyboard.exampleZh: 我每天用键盘打电子邮件和学校论文。

kick.example: He gave the ball a hard kick and it flew over the wall.
kick.exampleZh: 他用力踢了球一下，球飞过了墙。

kid.example: The kid next door likes to play with my dog every day.
kid.exampleZh: 隔壁的小孩喜欢每天和我的狗一起玩。

kill.example: He used a long walk to kill time before the train arrived.
kill.exampleZh: 他在火车到达前用一次长距离散步来消磨时间。

kilo.example: I bought a kilo of apples and a kilo of rice yesterday.
kilo.exampleZh: 我昨天买了一公斤苹果和一公斤大米。

kilogram.example: I bought a bag of rice that weighs exactly one kilogram.
kilogram.exampleZh: 我买了一袋正好重一公斤的大米。

kilometer.example: The school is one kilometer from my house, so I walk there every day.
kilometer.exampleZh: 学校离我家一公里，所以我每天步行去那里。

kind.example: She is very kind to her new classmates and helps them every day.
kind.exampleZh: 她对她的新同学非常友善，并且每天都帮助他们。

king.example: The old king lived in a big castle near the river.
king.exampleZh: 那位老国王住在河边的一座大城堡里。

kiss.example: She gave him a quick kiss on the cheek before leaving.
kiss.exampleZh: 她离开前在他脸颊上轻轻吻了一下。

kitchen.example: My mother is cooking dinner in the kitchen for our family.
kitchen.exampleZh: 我妈妈正在厨房里为我们全家做晚饭。

kite.example: The little boy is flying a red kite in the park with his father.
kite.exampleZh: 小男孩正和爸爸在公园里放一只红色的风筝。

knee.example: I hurt my knee when I fell off my bike yesterday.
knee.exampleZh: 昨天我从自行车上摔下来时伤到了膝盖。

knife.example: I used a sharp knife to cut the bread for breakfast.
knife.exampleZh: 我用一把锋利的刀切早餐吃的面包。

knock.example: I heard a loud knock at the door late last night.
knock.exampleZh: 我昨晚深夜听到门上有一声很大的敲门声。

know.example: I know the answer to this easy question now.
know.exampleZh: 我现在知道这个简单问题的答案了。

knowledge.example: She has a lot of knowledge about plants and animals.
knowledge.exampleZh: 她有很多关于植物和动物的知识。

lab.example: Our science teacher took us to the lab to do a simple experiment.
lab.exampleZh: 我们的科学老师带我们去实验室做了一个简单的实验。

ladder.example: He put the ladder against the wall to fix the roof.
ladder.exampleZh: 他把梯子靠在墙上修屋顶。

lady.example: The kind lady helped the lost child find his mother.
lady.exampleZh: 那位善良的女士帮助迷路的孩子找到了他的母亲。

lake.example: We walked around the lake and saw many small boats on the water.
lake.exampleZh: 我们绕着湖散步，看到水面上有许多小船。

lamp.example: I turned on the lamp beside my bed and read a book.
lamp.exampleZh: 我打开床边的灯，读了一本书。

land.example: The plane will land on the small island very soon.
land.exampleZh: 飞机很快就会降落在那个小岛上。

language.example: Learning a new language can be fun and useful for everyone.
language.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言对每个人来说都可能既有趣又有用。

large.example: A large crowd gathered in the square to watch the free concert.
large.exampleZh: 一大群人聚集在广场上观看免费音乐会。

last.example: This is the last train, so we must hurry home now.
last.exampleZh: 这是最后一班火车，所以我们现在必须赶快回家。

late.example: He was late for school because the bus did not come.
late.exampleZh: 他上学迟到了，因为公交车没有来。

lately.example: I have been very busy at work lately and feel quite tired.
lately.exampleZh: 最近我工作很忙，感觉相当累。

later.example: I will call you later when I finish my work.
later.exampleZh: 我完成工作后会给你打电话。

laugh.example: The children laugh loudly at the funny story in the book.
laugh.exampleZh: 孩子们因为书里有趣的故事而大声笑起来。

laughter.example: The sound of laughter filled the small room and made everyone smile.
laughter.exampleZh: 笑声充满了这个小房间，让每个人都笑了。

lazy.example: My lazy brother never cleans his room and always sleeps late on weekends.
lazy.exampleZh: 我懒惰的弟弟从不打扫房间，周末总是睡懒觉。

lead.example: She will lead the team to the new office tomorrow morning.
lead.exampleZh: 她明天早上将带领团队去新办公室。

leader.example: Our team leader always listens carefully and helps us solve problems.
leader.exampleZh: 我们的团队领导总是认真倾听，并帮助我们解决问题。

leaf.example: A green leaf fell from the tall tree and landed on the grass.
leaf.exampleZh: 一片绿叶从高高的树上落下，掉在了草地上。

learn.example: We learn new things every day at school and at home.
learn.exampleZh: 我们每天在学校和家里学习新事物。

least.example: This is the least expensive book in the whole store.
least.exampleZh: 这是整家店里最便宜的书。

leave.example: Please leave your keys on the table before you go home.
leave.exampleZh: 请在你回家前把钥匙留在桌子上。

left.example: The left side of the street has many small shops and cafes.
left.exampleZh: 街道的左边有许多小商店和咖啡馆。

leg.example: The table has one short leg, so it rocks when you write.
leg.exampleZh: 这张桌子有一条短腿，所以你写字时会摇晃。

lemon.example: I add a slice of lemon to my tea every morning.
lemon.exampleZh: 我每天早上往茶里加一片柠檬。

lend.example: Could you lend me your book for a few days?
lend.exampleZh: 你能把书借给我几天吗？

less.example: I have less free time this week than I did last week.
less.exampleZh: 我这周比上周空闲时间少。

lesson.example: This lesson is easy, but the next one will be harder.
lesson.exampleZh: 这节课很简单，但下一节会更难。

let.example: Let me help you carry those heavy boxes to the car.
let.exampleZh: 让我帮你把这些重箱子搬到车上。

letter.example: I wrote a short letter to my friend last night.
letter.exampleZh: 昨晚我给我的朋友写了一封短信。

level.example: She reached a high level in the game after months of practice.
level.exampleZh: 经过几个月的练习，她在游戏中达到了很高的水平。

library.example: I go to the library every day to read books with my friends.
library.exampleZh: 我每天和朋友们去图书馆看书。

lie.example: My dog likes to lie on the warm floor every afternoon.
lie.exampleZh: 我的狗喜欢每天下午躺在温暖的地板上。

life.example: She has a happy life with her family in a small town.
life.exampleZh: 她和家人在一个小镇上过着幸福的生活。

lift.example: I always lift the heavy box with both hands to protect my back.
lift.exampleZh: 我总是用双手抬起那个重箱子，以保护我的背部。

light.example: The room is bright because the light comes through the big window.
light.exampleZh: 房间很明亮，因为光线从大窗户照进来。

like.example: I like to read books in the park on sunny days.
like.exampleZh: 我喜欢在晴朗的日子去公园读书。

line.example: Please stand in a straight line and wait for your turn.
line.exampleZh: 请排成一条直线，等待轮到你。

lion.example: The lion sleeps under a big tree after a long day.
lion.exampleZh: 那头狮子在漫长的一天后睡在一棵大树下。

lip.example: She bit her lower lip and waited for the doctor.

list.example: Please make a list of the things we need for the trip.
list.exampleZh: 请列一份我们旅行需要的东西的清单。

listen.example: Please listen carefully to what your teacher says in class today.
listen.exampleZh: 请仔细听老师今天在课上说的话。

little.example: She has little time to play with her friends today.
little.exampleZh: 她今天几乎没有时间和朋友们玩。

live.example: My grandparents live in a small house near the river.
live.exampleZh: 我的祖父母住在河边的一栋小房子里。

lively.example: The lively children played games in the park all afternoon.
lively.exampleZh: 活泼的孩子们整个下午都在公园里玩游戏。

lonely.example: The old man lives alone and often feels lonely in his small house.
lonely.exampleZh: 这位老人独自生活，在他的小房子里常常感到孤独。

long.example: She has long hair and she longs to visit her family soon.
long.exampleZh: 她留着长发，并且渴望很快去看望家人。

look.example: You look tired today, so please sit down and rest for a while.
look.exampleZh: 你今天看起来很累，所以请坐下来休息一会儿。

loose.example: This shirt is too loose for me, so I will wear another one.
loose.exampleZh: 这件衬衫对我来说太宽松了，所以我会穿另一件。

lose.example: If you are not careful, you will lose your keys again.
lose.exampleZh: 如果你不小心，你会再次弄丢钥匙。

lot.example: A lot of people came to the park on Sunday.
lot.exampleZh: 星期天很多人来到了公园。

loud.example: The music is too loud, so please turn it down.
loud.exampleZh: 音乐太吵了，请把它调小一点。

love.example: I love to read books with my sister every night before bed.
love.exampleZh: 我喜欢每天晚上睡前和我妹妹一起读书。

lovely.example: We had a lovely time at the park with our friends yesterday.
lovely.exampleZh: 昨天我们和朋友们在公园度过了一段愉快的时光。

low.example: The chair is too low for my little brother to reach the table.
low.exampleZh: 这把椅子太矮了，我弟弟够不到桌子。

luck.example: I think good luck helped me win the game yesterday.
luck.exampleZh: 我觉得是好运帮助我昨天赢了比赛。

lucky.example: You are very lucky to have such good friends around you.
lucky.exampleZh: 你很幸运，身边有这么好的朋友。

lunch.example: I usually have lunch with my coworkers at a small restaurant near our office.
lunch.exampleZh: 我通常和同事在办公室附近的一家小餐馆吃午饭。

lung.example: Smoking can hurt your lungs and make it hard to breathe.
lung.exampleZh: 吸烟会伤害你的肺，并让你呼吸困难。

machine.example: The machine in the factory makes many small parts every day.
machine.exampleZh: 工厂里的这台机器每天制造许多小零件。

mad.example: My brother went mad when he lost his favorite old toy.
mad.exampleZh: 我弟弟弄丢他最喜欢的旧玩具时气疯了。

magazine.example: I bought a new magazine at the store yesterday morning.
magazine.exampleZh: 我昨天早上在商店买了一本新杂志。

magic.example: The children believe that the old book is full of magic.
magic.exampleZh: 孩子们相信这本旧书充满了魔法。

mail.example: I will mail the letter to my friend tomorrow morning.
mail.exampleZh: 我明天早上会把信寄给我的朋友。

main.example: The main road is closed today, so we must take another way.
main.exampleZh: 主路今天封闭了，所以我们必须走另一条路。

make.example: My mother will make a big cake for my birthday tomorrow.
make.exampleZh: 我妈妈明天会为我的生日做一个大蛋糕。

man.example: The old man walks slowly down the road with his dog.
man.exampleZh: 那位老人带着他的狗沿着路慢慢走。

manage.example: She can manage the small shop and still have time for her family.
manage.exampleZh: 她能经营这家小店，还能有时间陪家人。

manager.example: Our manager gave us a clear plan for the busy week.
manager.exampleZh: 我们的经理给了我们一个忙碌一周的明确计划。

many.example: Many people like to walk in the park on sunny days.
many.exampleZh: 许多人喜欢在晴天去公园散步。

map.example: I looked at the map to find the shortest way to the park.
map.exampleZh: 我看着地图寻找去公园的最短路线。

march.example: My birthday is in March and we always have a small party at home.
march.exampleZh: 我的生日在三月，我们总是在家里办一个小聚会。

mark.example: Please mark the right answer with a red pen on your test paper.
mark.exampleZh: 请用红笔在你的试卷上标记正确答案。

market.example: The local market is busy every Saturday morning with fresh fruit and vegetables.
market.exampleZh: 当地市场每周六上午都很热闹，有新鲜的水果和蔬菜。

marry.example: She wants to marry her best friend next spring in a small town.
marry.exampleZh: 她想明年春天在一个小镇上嫁给她最好的朋友。

match.example: I found a match to light the candle on the table.
match.exampleZh: 我在桌上找到一根火柴来点蜡烛。

math.example: I study math every day because I want to improve my skills.
math.exampleZh: 我每天学习数学，因为我想提高自己的能力。

matter.example: This is an important matter, and it matters to everyone here.
matter.exampleZh: 这是一件重要的事情，对这里的每个人都重要。

may.example: You may sit here and wait for the next bus.
may.exampleZh: 你可以坐在这里等下一班公交车。

maybe.example: Maybe it will rain tomorrow, so take an umbrella with you.
maybe.exampleZh: 也许明天会下雨，所以带把伞吧。

me.example: She gave me a book to read on the train.
me.exampleZh: 她在火车上给了我一本书读。

meal.example: We had a healthy meal together before everyone left for work this morning.
meal.exampleZh: 今天早上大家去上班前，我们一起吃了一顿健康的饭。

mean.example: I did not mean to hurt your feelings yesterday.
mean.exampleZh: 我昨天不是故意伤害你的感情。

meaning.example: The meaning of this word is easy to understand.
meaning.exampleZh: 这个单词的意思很容易理解。

means.example: This is a good means to solve the problem quickly.
means.exampleZh: 这是快速解决问题的一个好方法。

measure.example: We need to measure the length of this table before we buy a new cover.
measure.exampleZh: 我们需要在买新桌布之前量一下这张桌子的长度。

meat.example: I bought some fresh meat at the market to cook for dinner.
meat.exampleZh: 我在市场买了一些新鲜的肉来做晚饭。

medical.example: He works at a medical center near our home.
medical.exampleZh: 他在我们家附近的一家医疗中心工作。

medicine.example: The doctor gave me medicine to take twice a day after meals.
medicine.exampleZh: 医生给了我药，让我每天饭后吃两次。

meet.example: I will meet my friend at the station after school today.
meet.exampleZh: 今天放学后我会在车站见我的朋友。

meeting.example: We will have a short meeting in the office this afternoon.
meeting.exampleZh: 我们今天下午将在办公室开一个简短的会议。

member.example: Every member of the club must pay the fee before Friday.
member.exampleZh: 俱乐部的每位会员都必须在周五前缴纳会费。

memory.example: I have a good memory for names and faces.
memory.exampleZh: 我对名字和面孔有很好的记忆力。

mend.example: He tried to mend the old chair before his friends came home.
mend.exampleZh: 他试着在朋友们回家前修好那把旧椅子。

mention.example: She did not mention the problem during our short meeting yesterday.
mention.exampleZh: 她昨天在我们简短的会议上没有提到这个问题。

menu.example: The waiter gave us a menu with many simple and cheap dishes.
menu.exampleZh: 服务员给了我们一份菜单，上面有许多简单又便宜的菜。

merry.example: The children were merry and sang songs around the fire.
merry.exampleZh: 孩子们欢乐地围着火堆唱歌。

message.example: I left a message for you on the kitchen table this morning.
message.exampleZh: 今天早上我在厨房桌上给你留了一条消息。

metal.example: The old gate is made of strong metal and it looks very heavy.
metal.exampleZh: 这扇旧门是用坚固的金属做的，看起来很重。

method.example: This easy method helps students learn new words every day.
method.exampleZh: 这个简单的方法帮助学生每天学习新单词。

metre.example: The room is five metres long and three metres wide.
metre.exampleZh: 这个房间长五米，宽三米。

middle.example: The small table sits in the middle of the room.
middle.exampleZh: 那张小桌子放在房间中间。

might.example: She might come to the party with her brother tonight.
might.exampleZh: 她今晚可能会和她哥哥一起来参加聚会。

mile.example: The park is only a mile from my house and school.
mile.exampleZh: 公园离我家和学校只有一英里。

milk.example: I drink a glass of milk every morning before I go to school.
milk.exampleZh: 我每天早上上学前喝一杯牛奶。

million.example: There are more than one million people living in this city now.
million.exampleZh: 现在有超过一百万人生活在这座城市里。

mind.example: Please keep an open mind when you hear new ideas from other people.
mind.exampleZh: 当你听到别人的新想法时，请保持开放的心态。

mine.example: This old mine is dark, but the gold inside is mine.
mine.exampleZh: 这座旧矿很暗，但里面的金子是我的。

mineral.example: This mineral is important for strong bones and healthy teeth.
mineral.exampleZh: 这种矿物质对强壮的骨骼和健康的牙齿很重要。

minus.example: It is minus five degrees outside, so please wear a warm coat today.
minus.exampleZh: 外面零下五度，所以今天请穿一件暖和的外套。

minute.example: Please wait a minute while I find the right key.
minute.exampleZh: 请等一分钟，我去找正确的钥匙。

mirror.example: The mirror on the wall shows my face every morning.
mirror.exampleZh: 墙上的镜子每天早上照出我的脸。

miss.example: I missed the last bus and had to walk home in the rain.
miss.exampleZh: 我错过了末班公交车，只好在雨中走回家。

mistake.example: Everyone can make a mistake when they are tired and in a hurry.
mistake.exampleZh: 每个人在疲惫又匆忙时都可能犯错。

mix.example: Please mix the eggs and milk in this big bowl.
mix.exampleZh: 请把鸡蛋和牛奶在这个大碗里混合。

mobile.example: She uses her mobile phone to check the weather every morning.
mobile.exampleZh: 她每天早上用手机查看天气。

model.example: This model of the car is very popular among young people.
model.exampleZh: 这款汽车的型号在年轻人中非常受欢迎。

modern.example: Many people use modern phones to talk and work every day.
modern.exampleZh: 许多人每天用现代手机通话和工作。

mom.example: My mom makes breakfast for me every morning before school.
mom.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天早上上学前给我做早餐。

moment.example: Please wait a moment while I find the right answer for you.
moment.exampleZh: 请稍等片刻，我帮你找到正确的答案。

money.example: I save some money every month for my family and our future.
money.exampleZh: 我每个月都为家人和我们的未来存一些钱。

monitor.example: The class monitor helped the teacher carry the books to the classroom.
monitor.exampleZh: 班长帮老师把书搬到教室。

monkey.example: The little monkey climbed the tall tree and ate a banana.
monkey.exampleZh: 那只小猴子爬上高高的树，吃了一根香蕉。

month.example: I will visit my grandparents for one month this summer.
month.exampleZh: 今年夏天我会去看望祖父母一个月。

moon.example: The moon looks very bright and beautiful in the night sky.
moon.exampleZh: 月亮在夜空中看起来非常明亮美丽。

more.example: I need more time to finish this work today.
more.exampleZh: 我今天需要更多时间完成这项工作。

morning.example: I drink a cup of hot tea every morning before I go to work.
morning.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都会喝一杯热茶。

most.example: Most students in our class like to play football after school.
most.exampleZh: 我们班大多数学生喜欢放学后踢足球。

mother.example: My mother makes delicious soup for our family every Sunday.
mother.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期天都为我们家做美味的汤。

mountain.example: We climbed the high mountain and saw beautiful flowers along the way.
mountain.exampleZh: 我们爬上了那座高山，沿途看到了美丽的花朵。

mouse.example: The little mouse ran under the table when it heard a loud noise.
mouse.exampleZh: 小老鼠听到一声巨响，就跑到桌子下面了。

mouth.example: The mouth of the river is wide and calm in the morning.
mouth.exampleZh: 河口在早晨宽阔而平静。

move.example: Please move your chair closer to the window before the meeting starts.
move.exampleZh: 请在会议开始前把你的椅子挪近窗户。

movie.example: We watched a funny movie at home last night with our friends.
movie.exampleZh: 昨晚我们和朋友们在家看了一部有趣的电影。

much.example: I do not have much time to play games today.
much.exampleZh: 我今天没有很多时间玩游戏。

museum.example: We visited a small museum near the river with our school friends yesterday.
museum.exampleZh: 昨天我们和学校的朋友一起参观了河边的一座小博物馆。

music.example: I like to listen to music when I walk home after school.
music.exampleZh: 我喜欢放学后走回家时听音乐。

musical.example: She has a musical voice and loves to sing simple songs at home.
musical.exampleZh: 她有一副悦耳的嗓音，喜欢在家里唱简单的歌。

must.example: You must finish your homework before you go out to play with your friends.
must.exampleZh: 你必须先完成作业，才能出去和朋友玩。

my.example: My little brother likes to play football with me after school every day.
my.exampleZh: 我弟弟喜欢每天放学后和我一起踢足球。

myself.example: I made this cake myself for my best friend's birthday party.
myself.exampleZh: 我亲自为最好的朋友的生日派对做了这个蛋糕。

narrow.example: The street is too narrow for two cars to pass each other.
narrow.exampleZh: 这条街太窄了，两辆车无法并排通过。

nation.example: The whole nation was happy when the team won the big game.
nation.exampleZh: 当球队赢下这场重要比赛时，全国人民都很高兴。

national.example: The national team won the game and made everyone very happy.
national.exampleZh: 国家队赢了比赛，让每个人都很高兴。

native.example: She speaks English like a native and helps visitors in town.
native.exampleZh: 她说英语像本地人，并在镇上帮助游客。

natural.example: She has a natural talent for music and loves to sing.
natural.exampleZh: 她天生有音乐天赋，喜欢唱歌。

nature.example: It is in human nature to want to be happy and safe.
nature.exampleZh: 想获得幸福和安全是人的本性。

near.example: I live near a small park and often walk there after work.
near.exampleZh: 我住在小公园附近，下班后经常去那里散步。

nearby.example: There is a small park nearby, so we often walk there.
nearby.exampleZh: 附近有一个小公园，所以我们经常去那里散步。

nearly.example: I nearly missed the last bus home because I was late.
nearly.exampleZh: 我差点错过回家的末班车，因为我迟到了。

necessary.example: It is necessary to drink enough water every day for good health.
necessary.exampleZh: 每天喝足够的水对健康是必要的。

neck.example: She wore a warm scarf around her neck on a cold winter day.
neck.exampleZh: 她在寒冷的冬日里脖子上围着一条温暖的围巾。

need.example: I need to buy some food and water for my family today.
need.exampleZh: 我今天需要为家人买一些食物和水。

needle.example: The nurse used a clean needle to give him the medicine.
needle.exampleZh: 护士用一根干净的针给他打针。

neighbour.example: My neighbour often helps me carry heavy bags to my home.
neighbour.exampleZh: 我的邻居经常帮我把沉重的袋子搬回家。

neither.example: Neither of my two brothers likes to play football in the rain.
neither.exampleZh: 我的两个兄弟都不喜欢在雨中踢足球。

nephew.example: My nephew lives in a small town near the sea with his family.
nephew.exampleZh: 我的侄子和他的家人住在海边的一个小镇上。

nervous.example: She felt nervous before the exam, so she took a deep breath.
nervous.exampleZh: 考试前她感到紧张，所以她深吸了一口气。

net.example: The fisherman repaired his old net before going out to sea.
net.exampleZh: 渔夫出海前修补了他的旧网。

never.example: I never drink coffee after eight in the evening because it keeps me awake.
never.exampleZh: 我晚上八点以后从不喝咖啡，因为它让我睡不着。

new.example: I bought a new phone and a new bag today.
new.exampleZh: 我今天买了一部新手机和一个新包。

news.example: I heard the news about the new park on my way home.
news.exampleZh: 我在回家路上听说了关于新公园的消息。

newspaper.example: My father reads the newspaper every morning before he goes to work.
newspaper.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上去上班前都会看报纸。

next.example: I will see you next week at the same place.
next.exampleZh: 我下周会在同一个地方见你。

nice.example: She is very nice to everyone and often helps her friends.
nice.exampleZh: 她对每个人都很友善，还经常帮助朋友。

night.example: I like to read a book in bed at night.
night.exampleZh: 我喜欢晚上在床上看书。

no.example: There is no milk in the fridge, so we need to buy some.
no.exampleZh: 冰箱里没有牛奶了，所以我们需要买一些。

nobody.example: Nobody in our class knew the answer to that easy question.
nobody.exampleZh: 我们班上没有人知道那个简单问题的答案。

nod.example: She gave a quick nod and then walked out of the room.
nod.exampleZh: 她快速点了点头，然后走出了房间。

noise.example: The loud noise from the street woke me up early this morning.
noise.exampleZh: 街上很大的噪音今天早上把我早早吵醒了。

noisy.example: The street outside my window is very noisy at night.
noisy.exampleZh: 我窗外的街道晚上很吵。

none.example: I looked in every room, but none of the keys were there.
none.exampleZh: 我找遍了每个房间，但那些钥匙一把都不在那里。

noodle.example: I like to eat noodles with vegetables and eggs for lunch.
noodle.exampleZh: 我午餐喜欢吃面条配蔬菜和鸡蛋。

noon.example: We will meet at noon and then have lunch together.
noon.exampleZh: 我们中午见面，然后一起吃午饭。

nor.example: He did not call me, nor did he send a message.
nor.exampleZh: 他没有给我打电话，也没有发消息。

normal.example: It is normal to feel tired after a long day at work.
normal.exampleZh: 工作了一整天后感到疲倦是正常的。

north.example: The cold wind comes from the north in winter.
north.exampleZh: 冬天，寒冷的风从北方吹来。

northern.example: The northern part of the country is cold in winter.
northern.exampleZh: 这个国家的北部冬天很冷。

nose.example: My nose is blocked, so I cannot smell the flowers today.
nose.exampleZh: 我鼻子塞住了，所以今天闻不到花香。

not.example: I am not hungry now, but I will eat later.
not.exampleZh: 我现在不饿，但稍后会吃。

note.example: Please note the important details in your notebook before the meeting starts.
note.exampleZh: 请在会议开始前把重要细节记在你的笔记本上。

notebook.example: I put my notebook on the desk and started to study.
notebook.exampleZh: 我把笔记本放在书桌上，开始学习。

nothing.example: There is nothing in the old box on the shelf.
nothing.exampleZh: 架子上的那个旧盒子里什么都没有。

notice.example: I did not notice the small sign on the door.
notice.exampleZh: 我没有注意到门上的小牌子。

novel.example: She wrote a novel about a young girl and her dog.
novel.exampleZh: 她写了一部关于一个小女孩和她的狗的小说。

now.example: You should go home now because it is getting dark outside.
now.exampleZh: 你现在应该回家，因为外面天快黑了。

nowadays.example: Nowadays many people use their phones to read news every morning.
nowadays.exampleZh: 现今许多人每天早上用手机看新闻。

number.example: Please write your phone number at the top of this page.
number.exampleZh: 请把你的电话号码写在这一页的顶部。

nurse.example: The nurse helped the sick child feel calm and safe.
nurse.exampleZh: 护士帮助生病的孩子感到平静和安全。

nut.example: I put a small nut on the table next to the red apple.
nut.exampleZh: 我把一颗小坚果放在红苹果旁边的桌子上。

o'clock.example: I usually get up at six o'clock in the morning.

ocean.example: The ocean is deep and blue, and many fish live in it.
ocean.exampleZh: 海洋又深又蓝，许多鱼生活在里面。

october.example: We will visit our grandparents in October and stay for a few days.
october.exampleZh: 我们将在十月去看望祖父母，并住几天。

of.example: The color of the sky changes from blue to orange at sunset.
of.exampleZh: 天空的颜色在日落时从蓝色变成橙色。

off.example: She got off the bus and walked to the small shop.
off.exampleZh: 她下了公交车，走向那家小商店。

offer.example: She decided to offer her old books to the school library.
offer.exampleZh: 她决定把旧书提供给学校图书馆。

office.example: She works in a small office near the train station every day.
office.exampleZh: 她每天在火车站附近的一间小办公室工作。

officer.example: The police officer helped the lost child find her mother.
officer.exampleZh: 这名警官帮助走失的孩子找到了她的母亲。

official.example: The official said the new rule will start next week.
official.exampleZh: 这位官员说新规定将于下周开始实施。

often.example: I often walk to the park with my friends on sunny days.
often.exampleZh: 晴天我经常和朋友们一起走路去公园。

oil.example: The car needs new oil before we drive to the city.
oil.exampleZh: 在我们开车去城里之前，这辆车需要新的机油。

ok.example: I feel ok today, so I will go to work as usual.
ok.exampleZh: 我今天感觉还可以，所以我会照常去上班。

old.example: My old bike is slow, but I still like to ride it every day.
old.exampleZh: 我的旧自行车很慢，但我仍然喜欢每天骑它。

olympic.example: The Olympic Games bring many people from different countries together every four years.
olympic.exampleZh: 奥运会每四年将来自不同国家的许多人聚集在一起。

once.example: Once you start, you will find the work easy.
once.exampleZh: 一旦你开始，你就会发现这项工作很容易。

one.example: One of my friends lives near the park and walks there every day.
one.exampleZh: 我的一个朋友住在公园附近，每天步行去那里。

oneself.example: It is important to learn how to take care of oneself.
oneself.exampleZh: 学会如何照顾自己很重要。

only.example: This is the only key that can open the old front door.
only.exampleZh: 这是唯一能打开那扇旧前门的钥匙。

oops.example: Oops, I dropped my pencil on the floor again.
oops.exampleZh: 哎哟，我又把铅笔掉到地上了。

open.example: Please open the window and let some fresh air into the room.
open.exampleZh: 请打开窗户，让一些新鲜空气进入房间。

opera.example: My sister loves opera and often listens to it at home.
opera.exampleZh: 我妹妹喜欢歌剧，经常在家听歌剧。

operate.example: Doctors often operate on patients who have serious health problems.
operate.exampleZh: 医生经常为患有严重健康问题的病人做手术。

operation.example: The doctor said the operation went well and she can go home soon.
operation.exampleZh: 医生说手术很顺利，她很快就可以回家。

opinion.example: In my opinion, this book is very useful for your English study.
opinion.exampleZh: 在我看来，这本书对你的英语学习非常有用。

opposite.example: The bank is opposite the post office, so we can walk there.
opposite.exampleZh: 银行在邮局对面，所以我们可以走到那里。

or.example: You can take the bus or walk to school today.
or.exampleZh: 你今天可以乘公交车或步行去学校。

orange.example: I like to eat an orange after lunch every day.
orange.exampleZh: 我喜欢每天午饭后吃一个橙子。

order.example: Please put these books in order before you leave the room.
order.exampleZh: 请在离开房间前把这些书按顺序放好。

orderly.example: The books on the shelf are neat and orderly after we clean the room.
orderly.exampleZh: 我们打扫房间后，书架上的书整齐有序。

ordinary.example: He is just an ordinary man who works hard every day.
ordinary.exampleZh: 他只是一个每天努力工作的普通人。

organise.example: We need to organise a small meeting for the new students next week.
organise.exampleZh: 我们需要在下周为新生组织一个小型会议。

organization.example: She works for a large organization that helps young people find jobs.
organization.exampleZh: 她在一家帮助年轻人找工作的庞大机构工作。

other.example: Some students like math, but other students prefer music and art.
other.exampleZh: 有些学生喜欢数学，但其他学生更喜欢音乐和美术。

otherwise.example: You should leave now, otherwise you will miss the last bus home.
otherwise.exampleZh: 你现在应该离开，否则你会错过回家的末班车。

ought.example: You ought to say sorry to your friend for being late.
ought.exampleZh: 你应该为迟到向朋友道歉。

our.example: Our teacher gave us a small test before the class started today.
our.exampleZh: 我们的老师在今天上课前给我们做了一次小测验。

ours.example: This new garden is ours, so we can plant flowers here.
ours.exampleZh: 这个新花园是我们的，所以我们可以在这里种花。

ourselves.example: We should learn to take care of ourselves when we are far from home.
ourselves.exampleZh: 当我们远离家乡时，我们应该学会照顾好自己。

out.example: He went out to buy some bread and milk for breakfast.
out.exampleZh: 他出去买了一些面包和牛奶当早餐。

outdoor.example: We had a fun outdoor picnic with our friends last Saturday.
outdoor.exampleZh: 上周六我们和朋友们进行了一次有趣的户外野餐。

outdoors.example: We like to play outdoors with our friends after school on sunny days.
outdoors.exampleZh: 我们喜欢在晴朗的日子放学后和朋友们在户外玩耍。

outside.example: The children are playing outside in the garden while their mother cooks dinner.
outside.exampleZh: 妈妈做晚饭的时候，孩子们在花园里外面玩耍。

over.example: The plane flew over the tall mountains before it landed safely.
over.exampleZh: 飞机在安全降落前飞越了高山。

overcoat.example: He put on his warm overcoat and walked to the bus stop.
overcoat.exampleZh: 他穿上温暖的大衣，走到公交车站。

overcome.example: She worked hard to overcome her fear of speaking in public.
overcome.exampleZh: 她努力克服了自己对当众讲话的恐惧。

own.example: I want to have my own room with a big desk and many books.
own.exampleZh: 我想有一个自己的房间，里面有一张大桌子和很多书。

owner.example: The owner of the small shop is always kind to us.
owner.exampleZh: 这家小店的店主总是对我们很友好。

page.example: Please turn to the next page and read the first paragraph aloud.
page.exampleZh: 请翻到下一页，并大声朗读第一段。

pain.example: She felt a sharp pain in her back after the long walk.
pain.exampleZh: 长时间散步后，她感到背部一阵剧痛。

paint.example: We used blue paint to make the old wall look new again.
paint.exampleZh: 我们用蓝色油漆让旧墙看起来焕然一新。

painting.example: There is a beautiful painting of a small lake on the wall.
painting.exampleZh: 墙上有一幅画着小湖泊的美丽油画。

pair.example: I bought a new pair of shoes for my brother yesterday.
pair.exampleZh: 我昨天给我弟弟买了一双新鞋。

palace.example: The old king lived in a large palace near the river.
palace.exampleZh: 老国王住在河边一座很大的宫殿里。

pale.example: Her face looked pale after the long walk in the cold wind.
pale.exampleZh: 她在冷风中走了很久后，脸色看起来很苍白。

pan.example: She put the hot pan on the table and waited for dinner.
pan.exampleZh: 她把热平底锅放在桌上，等着吃晚饭。

pancake.example: I made a pancake for breakfast and ate it with honey.
pancake.exampleZh: 我早餐做了一个薄饼，还配着蜂蜜吃了。

panda.example: The panda is eating bamboo in the zoo with its baby.
panda.exampleZh: 熊猫正在动物园里和它的宝宝一起吃竹子。

paper.example: I wrote my name on a piece of paper before class.
paper.exampleZh: 我在上课前把名字写在一张纸上。

parent.example: My parent always helps me with my homework after school every day.
parent.exampleZh: 我的父亲或母亲每天放学后总是帮我做作业。

park.example: We often walk in the park after dinner on sunny days.
park.exampleZh: 晴天晚饭后我们经常在公园里散步。

part.example: She played an important part in the school play last week.
part.exampleZh: 她在上周的学校戏剧中扮演了重要角色。

part-time.example: She works part-time at a small bookshop near her home.
part-time.exampleZh: 她在离家不远的一家小书店兼职。

party.example: We are going to a birthday party at my friend's house this evening.
party.exampleZh: 今晚我们要去我朋友家参加一个生日聚会。

pass.example: Please pass me the salt, and I will pass the exam tomorrow.
pass.exampleZh: 请把盐递给我，我明天会通过考试。

passage.example: A narrow passage leads from the kitchen to the back garden.
passage.exampleZh: 一条狭窄的通道从厨房通向后花园。

passenger.example: The passenger asked the driver to stop at the next station.
passenger.exampleZh: 乘客请司机在下一站停车。

passport.example: I need my passport before I can travel to another country.
passport.exampleZh: 我需要我的护照才能去另一个国家旅行。

past.example: I walked past the old school on my way home yesterday.
past.exampleZh: 昨天我在回家的路上经过了那所旧学校。

path.example: We walked along a narrow path through the green forest after lunch.
path.exampleZh: 午饭后，我们沿着一条穿过绿色森林的狭窄小路散步。

patient.example: The doctor is very patient with young children and answers their questions.
patient.exampleZh: 这位医生对年幼的孩子非常有耐心，并回答他们的问题。

pay.example: I will pay for dinner tonight because you paid last week.
pay.exampleZh: 今晚我来付晚餐的钱，因为上周是你付的。

pe.example: I like my pe class because we play fun games outside.
pe.exampleZh: 我喜欢我的体育课，因为我们在外面玩有趣的游戏。

peace.example: After the war, the whole country finally enjoyed a long period of peace.
peace.exampleZh: 战争结束后，整个国家终于享受了长期的和平。

peach.example: I ate a sweet peach after lunch in the garden today.
peach.exampleZh: 我今天午餐后在花园里吃了一个甜桃子。

pear.example: My mother bought a sweet pear at the market this morning
pear.exampleZh: 我妈妈今天早上在市场买了一个甜梨。

pen.example: I use a blue pen to write my name in my notebook.
pen.exampleZh: 我用一支蓝色钢笔在我的笔记本上写我的名字。

pencil.example: I use a pencil to draw a picture in my notebook.
pencil.exampleZh: 我用铅笔在笔记本上画一幅画。

penny.example: I found a shiny penny on the sidewalk near my school.
penny.exampleZh: 我在学校附近的人行道上发现了一枚闪亮的便士。

people.example: Many people around the world want to live in peace.
people.exampleZh: 世界上许多人都希望和平地生活。

pepper.example: I put a little black pepper on my eggs every morning.
pepper.exampleZh: 我每天早上在鸡蛋上放一点黑胡椒。

per.example: The bus leaves once per hour from the station near my home.
per.exampleZh: 公交车每小时从我家附近的车站发一班。

percent.example: About twenty percent of the students in our class walk to school every day.
percent.exampleZh: 我们班大约百分之二十的学生每天步行上学。

perfect.example: The weather is perfect for a picnic in the park today.
perfect.exampleZh: 今天天气非常适合在公园野餐。

perform.example: She will perform a short dance for us at the school show.
perform.exampleZh: 她将在学校演出上为我们表演一段简短的舞蹈。

perhaps.example: Perhaps we can meet at the park after lunch today.
perhaps.exampleZh: 也许我们今天午饭后可以在公园见面。

period.example: This period of history was very hard for many poor families.
period.exampleZh: 这段历史时期对许多贫困家庭来说非常艰难。

person.example: Every person in the room was quiet during the meeting.
person.exampleZh: 会议期间房间里的每个人都很安静。

personal.example: She keeps her personal things in a small box under the bed.
personal.exampleZh: 她把私人物品放在床下的一个小盒子里。

pet.example: My pet dog likes to sleep on the sofa every afternoon.
pet.exampleZh: 我的宠物狗喜欢每天下午睡在沙发上。

phone.example: I need to phone my mother when I get home tonight.
phone.exampleZh: 我今晚到家后需要给妈妈打个电话。

photo.example: I took a photo of my family at the park yesterday.
photo.exampleZh: 昨天我在公园给家人拍了一张照片。

phrase.example: This common phrase is easy to understand and use in daily conversation.
phrase.exampleZh: 这个常用短语很容易理解，也适合在日常对话中使用。

physics.example: My brother studies physics at school and wants to become a teacher.
physics.exampleZh: 我哥哥在学校学物理，他想成为一名老师。

piano.example: My sister plays the piano every evening after she finishes her homework.
piano.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天傍晚做完作业后弹钢琴。

pick.example: You can pick some fresh apples from the tree in our garden.
pick.exampleZh: 你可以从我们花园的树上摘一些新鲜的苹果。

picnic.example: We will have a picnic in the park with our friends this Sunday.
picnic.exampleZh: 这个星期天我们将和朋友们在公园野餐。

picture.example: I put a picture of my family on the wall.
picture.exampleZh: 我把一张全家福照片挂在墙上。

pie.example: My mother made a sweet apple pie for our family dinner last night.
pie.exampleZh: 昨晚我妈妈为我们家的晚餐做了一个香甜的苹果派。

piece.example: She found a small piece of paper under the old wooden table.
piece.exampleZh: 她在旧木桌下发现了一小片纸。

pig.example: The farmer keeps a big pig and two small chickens on his farm.
pig.exampleZh: 农夫在他的农场里养了一头大猪和两只小鸡。

pilot.example: The pilot checked the plane before the long flight.
pilot.exampleZh: 飞行员在长途飞行前检查了飞机。

pin.example: She used a pin to fix the broken strap on her bag.
pin.exampleZh: 她用一枚别针固定了包上断了的带子。

pine.example: There is a tall pine near the lake behind our house.
pine.exampleZh: 我们家后面的湖边有一棵高大的松树。

pink.example: She wore a pink dress to the party last night.
pink.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条粉红色的连衣裙去参加聚会。

pioneer.example: She was a pioneer in the fight for equal rights.
pioneer.exampleZh: 她是争取平等权利斗争中的一位先锋。

pipe.example: The old man cleaned his pipe before he sat down by the fire.
pipe.exampleZh: 老人在炉火旁坐下前清理了他的烟斗。

pizza.example: My family likes to eat pizza together on Friday nights at home.
pizza.exampleZh: 我的家人喜欢周五晚上在家一起吃比萨饼。

place.example: Please place your bag in a safe place near the door.
place.exampleZh: 请把你的包放在门附近一个安全的地方。

plan.example: We made a plan to visit the museum this weekend.
plan.exampleZh: 我们制定了一个计划，这个周末去参观博物馆。

plane.example: The plane is flying above the clouds on a sunny day.
plane.exampleZh: 飞机在晴朗的日子里飞在云层上方。

planet.example: Earth is the only planet in our solar system with life.
planet.exampleZh: 地球是我们太阳系中唯一有生命的行星。

plant.example: We planted a small tree in the garden behind our new factory.
plant.exampleZh: 我们在新工厂后面的花园里种了一棵小树。

plastic.example: She keeps her lunch in a small plastic box every day.
plastic.exampleZh: 她每天把午餐放在一个小塑料盒里。

plate.example: She put the clean plate on the table and smiled at me.
plate.exampleZh: 她把干净的盘子放在桌上，对我笑了笑。

play.example: The children play a fun game in the park every day.
play.exampleZh: 孩子们每天在公园里玩一个有趣的游戏。

player.example: The young player scored a goal and made the whole team very happy.
player.exampleZh: 这位年轻运动员进了一球，让全队非常高兴。

playground.example: The children are playing happily on the new playground after school.
playground.exampleZh: 孩子们放学后在新操场上开心地玩耍。

pleasant.example: The weather was pleasant, so we took a walk in the park.
pleasant.exampleZh: 天气很宜人，所以我们在公园里散了步。

please.example: The kind teacher tries to please every student in her class.
please.exampleZh: 这位和善的老师努力让班上每个学生都满意。

pleased.example: I am very pleased to meet you and your family today.
pleased.exampleZh: 今天见到你和你的家人我非常高兴。

pleasure.example: It gives me great pleasure to meet you and your family today.
pleasure.exampleZh: 今天见到你和你的家人让我非常高兴。

plenty.example: We have plenty of time to finish the work today.
plenty.exampleZh: 我们今天有充足的时间完成这项工作。

plug.example: Please put the plug into the wall socket before you turn on the machine.
plug.exampleZh: 请在你启动机器之前把插头插进墙上的插座。

plus.example: Two plus three is five, and the result is a positive number.
plus.exampleZh: 二加三等于五，结果是一个正数。

pocket.example: He put his keys in his pocket and left the house.
pocket.exampleZh: 他把钥匙放进衣袋里，然后离开了家。

poem.example: She wrote a short poem about the sea for her class.
poem.exampleZh: 她为班级写了一首关于大海的短诗。

poet.example: The young poet wrote a short poem about the quiet sea.
poet.exampleZh: 这位年轻的诗人写了一首关于宁静大海的短诗。

point.example: Please point to the red dot on the map for me.
point.exampleZh: 请指给我看地图上的红点。

poison.example: The old farmer warned the children that the poison was very dangerous for them.
poison.exampleZh: 那位老农夫警告孩子们，那毒药对他们非常危险。

police.example: The police arrived quickly after someone called them about the noise.
police.exampleZh: 有人打电话举报噪音后，警察很快就到了。

policeman.example: The policeman helped the lost child find his mother on the busy street.
policeman.exampleZh: 警察帮助走失的孩子在繁忙的街道上找到了他的母亲。

policy.example: The new policy will help small businesses grow.
policy.exampleZh: 新政策将帮助小企业成长。

polite.example: She is always polite to her teachers and classmates at school.
polite.exampleZh: 她在学校总是对老师和同学很有礼貌。

pool.example: The children swam in the small pool behind their house on a hot day.
pool.exampleZh: 孩子们在一个炎热的日子里在他们房子后面的小水池里游泳。

poor.example: The poor family needs food and warm clothes for the cold winter.
poor.exampleZh: 这个贫困家庭需要食物和保暖衣物来度过寒冷的冬天。

pop.example: Pop music is very popular with young people around the world.
pop.exampleZh: 流行音乐在世界各地的年轻人中非常受欢迎。

popular.example: This song is very popular with young people in my city.
popular.exampleZh: 这首歌在我所在城市的年轻人中非常受欢迎。

population.example: The population of our city is growing very fast this year.
population.exampleZh: 我们城市的人口今年增长得很快。

pork.example: My mother cooked pork with fresh vegetables for our family dinner last night.
pork.exampleZh: 昨晚我妈妈为我们的家庭晚餐做了猪肉和新鲜蔬菜。

port.example: The ship arrived at the port early in the morning.

position.example: He found a good position near the window and sat down.
position.exampleZh: 他在窗边找到一个好位置并坐了下来。

possible.example: It is possible to finish this work before Friday.
possible.exampleZh: 在星期五之前完成这项工作是有可能的。

possibly.example: The train is late, so we will possibly miss our flight.
possibly.exampleZh: 火车晚点了，所以我们可能会错过航班。

post.example: I will post the letter tomorrow morning at the small post office.
post.exampleZh: 明天早上我会在那家小邮局寄这封信。

postcard.example: I sent a postcard to my friend from the beach last summer.
postcard.exampleZh: 去年夏天我从海滩给朋友寄了一张明信片。

poster.example: I saw a colorful poster for the school concert on the wall.
poster.exampleZh: 我在墙上看到了一张色彩鲜艳的学校音乐会海报。

pot.example: She put the hot pot on the table for dinner.
pot.exampleZh: 她把热锅放在桌上准备吃晚饭。

potato.example: I bought two potatoes and some carrots at the small market yesterday.
potato.exampleZh: 昨天我在小市场买了两个土豆和一些胡萝卜。

pound.example: I bought two pounds of apples for five pounds at the market.
pound.exampleZh: 我在市场花五英镑买了两磅苹果。

pour.example: Please pour the milk into the glass slowly and carefully.
pour.exampleZh: 请慢慢小心地把牛奶倒进玻璃杯里。

power.example: The new king used his power to help poor people.
power.exampleZh: 新国王用他的权力帮助穷人。

powerful.example: A powerful engine can help a small car go up the hill.
powerful.exampleZh: 一台强大的发动机能帮助小汽车爬上这座山。

practical.example: We need a practical plan that is easy to follow every day.
practical.exampleZh: 我们需要一个每天容易执行的实用计划。

practice.example: I need more practice before I can play this song well.
practice.exampleZh: 我需要更多练习才能把这首歌弹好。

practise.example: You need to practise your English every day to get better.
practise.exampleZh: 你需要每天练习英语才能变得更好。

praise.example: Teachers should praise students often for their hard work and kind behavior.
praise.exampleZh: 老师应该经常表扬学生的努力和友善行为。

pray.example: Every night before bed, the children pray for their parents and friends.
pray.exampleZh: 每天晚上睡觉前，孩子们为父母和朋友祈祷。

prefer.example: I prefer tea in the morning, but my sister likes coffee.
prefer.exampleZh: 我早上更喜欢茶，但我妹妹喜欢咖啡。

prepare.example: We need to prepare dinner before our friends arrive at six.
prepare.exampleZh: 我们需要在朋友们六点到达之前准备好晚餐。

present.example: She was present at the meeting and gave him a small present.
present.exampleZh: 她出席了会议，并给了他一份小礼物。

president.example: The president gave a short speech to the students this morning.
president.exampleZh: 总统今天上午向学生们作了简短讲话。

press.example: Please press the red button to start the machine.
press.exampleZh: 请按红色按钮启动机器。

pretty.example: She looks pretty in that blue dress and everyone at the party agrees.
pretty.exampleZh: 她穿那条蓝色连衣裙很漂亮，聚会上的每个人都这么认为。

prevent.example: Wash your hands often to prevent the spread of germs.
prevent.exampleZh: 经常洗手以防止细菌传播。

price.example: The price of this book is too high for me to buy.
price.exampleZh: 这本书的价格太高了，我买不起。

pride.example: She felt great pride when her son finished the race.
pride.exampleZh: 当她的儿子跑完比赛时，她感到非常自豪。

primary.example: Our primary goal is to keep the children safe and healthy.
primary.exampleZh: 我们的首要目标是保证孩子们的安全和健康。

print.example: I will print two copies of the report for the meeting.
print.exampleZh: 我会为会议打印两份报告。

private.example: She does not talk about her private life at work.
private.exampleZh: 她在工作中不谈自己的私人生活。

prize.example: She won first prize in the school singing contest last week.
prize.exampleZh: 她上周在学校唱歌比赛中获得了一等奖。

probably.example: She is probably at home now because her car is still outside.
probably.exampleZh: 她现在很可能在家，因为她的车还停在外面。

problem.example: We must find a way to solve this problem today.
problem.exampleZh: 我们必须今天找到解决这个问题的办法。

produce.example: This factory can produce many cheap toys for children every day.
produce.exampleZh: 这家工厂每天能为孩子们生产许多便宜的玩具。

product.example: This new product is very easy to use at home.
product.exampleZh: 这款新产品在家里使用起来非常方便。

programme.example: The new programme on television is very interesting for young children.
programme.exampleZh: 电视上的新节目对小孩子来说非常有趣。

progress.example: She made great progress in English this year and felt very happy.
progress.exampleZh: 她今年在英语方面取得了很大进步，感到非常高兴。

promise.example: I promise to call you as soon as I get home tonight.
promise.exampleZh: 我答应今晚一到家就给你打电话。

pronounce.example: Can you pronounce this word clearly for the whole class?
pronounce.exampleZh: 你能为全班清楚地读出这个单词的发音吗？

pronunciation.example: Good pronunciation helps people understand you more easily every day.
pronunciation.exampleZh: 良好的发音能帮助人们每天更容易地理解你。

proof.example: The police found clear proof that he was at the scene.
proof.exampleZh: 警方找到了他在现场的确凿证据。

proper.example: It is important to use the proper tools for each job.
proper.exampleZh: 为每项工作使用合适的工具很重要。

protect.example: We should protect our eyes when we work in the bright sun.
protect.exampleZh: 我们在强光下工作时应该保护眼睛。

proud.example: She felt proud of her son when he finished the race.
proud.exampleZh: 当她儿子跑完比赛时，她为他感到骄傲。

prove.example: The test results prove that he is right about the answer.
prove.exampleZh: 测试结果证明他对这个答案的看法是对的。

provide.example: The school will provide free books and lunch for every student this year.
provide.exampleZh: 学校今年将为每位学生提供免费书籍和午餐。

public.example: The public park is open to everyone every day.
public.exampleZh: 这个公共公园每天都向所有人开放。

pull.example: Please pull the heavy box across the room to the door.
pull.exampleZh: 请把那个沉重的箱子从房间那头拉到门口。

punish.example: The teacher will punish students who cheat on the test.
punish.exampleZh: 老师会惩罚在考试中作弊的学生。

pupil.example: The pupil reads a book with her teacher every morning.
pupil.exampleZh: 这个小女孩每天早上和老师一起读一本书。

pure.example: The water in this mountain lake is pure and safe to drink.
pure.exampleZh: 这个山间湖泊里的水是纯净的，可以安全饮用。

push.example: Please push the door gently and it will open.
push.exampleZh: 请轻轻推一下门，它就会开。

put.example: Please put the books on the table before you leave.
put.exampleZh: 请在你离开之前把书放在桌子上。

puzzle.example: The answer to this puzzle still puzzles me after a long night.
puzzle.exampleZh: 这个谜题的答案让我琢磨了一整晚，仍然感到困惑。

quarter.example: I only need a quarter of the cake for my little brother.
quarter.exampleZh: 我只需要四分之一块蛋糕给我的小弟弟。

queen.example: The queen lives in a big palace with her family.
queen.exampleZh: 女王和她的家人住在一座大宫殿里。

question.example: I have a question about the homework, so I will ask my teacher.
question.exampleZh: 关于作业我有一个问题，所以我会去问老师。

queue.example: We stood in a long queue to buy tickets for the concert.
queue.exampleZh: 我们排了很长的队去买音乐会的票。

quick.example: She is very quick at math and always finishes her work first.
quick.exampleZh: 她数学很快，总是第一个完成作业。

quiet.example: The library is very quiet in the early morning.
quiet.exampleZh: 清晨的图书馆非常安静。

quite.example: The test was quite hard, but I finished it before lunch.
quite.exampleZh: 这次考试相当难，但我在午饭前就做完了。

quiz.example: Our teacher gives us a short quiz every Friday morning.
quiz.exampleZh: 我们老师每周五上午都会给我们做一个小测验。

rabbit.example: The white rabbit ran quickly across the green grass and into a hole.
rabbit.exampleZh: 那只白兔迅速跑过绿草地，钻进了一个洞里。

race.example: The race starts at nine, and all the students will run fast.
race.exampleZh: 比赛九点开始，所有学生都会跑得很快。

radio.example: My grandfather listens to the radio every morning while he eats breakfast.
radio.exampleZh: 我爷爷每天早上一边吃早饭一边听收音机。

rail.example: Hold the rail tightly when you walk down the stairs.
rail.exampleZh: 下楼梯时请紧紧抓住栏杆。

railway.example: The railway runs along the river and past the old town.
railway.exampleZh: 这条铁路沿着河边延伸，经过那座老城。

rain.example: It began to rain in the afternoon, so we stayed at home.
rain.exampleZh: 下午开始下雨了，所以我们待在家里。

rainbow.example: After the rain, a beautiful rainbow appeared in the sky.
rainbow.exampleZh: 雨后，天空中出现了美丽的彩虹。

raincoat.example: I always wear a raincoat when it rains heavily outside.
raincoat.exampleZh: 外面下大雨时，我总是穿雨衣。

raise.example: She raised her hand to ask the teacher a question.

rapid.example: The rapid growth of the city surprised all the new visitors.
rapid.exampleZh: 这座城市的快速发展让所有新来的游客感到惊讶。

rat.example: A big rat ran across the kitchen floor last night.
rat.exampleZh: 昨晚一只大老鼠跑过厨房地板。

rather.example: I would rather stay home tonight because the weather is rather cold.
rather.exampleZh: 今晚我宁愿待在家里，因为天气有点儿冷。

reach.example: We will reach the train station before six o'clock.
reach.exampleZh: 我们将在六点前到达火车站。

read.example: I read a short book to my little sister every night.
read.exampleZh: 我每天晚上给我的小妹妹读一本短书。

ready.example: She is always ready to help her friends with their homework.
ready.exampleZh: 她总是乐意帮助朋友们做作业。

real.example: This is a real diamond, not a cheap copy.
real.exampleZh: 这是一颗真正的钻石，不是廉价仿制品。

realise.example: I did not realise how late it was until my mother called me.
realise.exampleZh: 直到妈妈给我打电话，我才意识到时间已经很晚了。

really.example: She is really happy when she plays with her dog.
really.exampleZh: 她和狗一起玩的时候真的很开心。

reason.example: The main reason for his success is hard work and patience.
reason.exampleZh: 他成功的主要原因是努力和耐心。

receive.example: I receive a letter from my best friend every month.
receive.exampleZh: 我每个月都会收到我最好的朋友寄来的一封信。

recent.example: I have not seen him in recent weeks.
recent.exampleZh: 最近几周我都没见过他。

recipe.example: My mother gave me her recipe for making apple pie.
recipe.exampleZh: 我妈妈把她做苹果派的食谱给了我。

recite.example: Every morning the students recite a short poem in class.
recite.exampleZh: 每天早上学生们在课堂上背诵一首短诗。

record.example: She keeps a record of every test score in a small notebook.
record.exampleZh: 她把每次考试的分数都记录在一个小笔记本里。

recycle.example: We recycle old paper and bottles at school every week.
recycle.exampleZh: 我们每周在学校回收旧纸张和瓶子。

red.example: She is wearing a red dress today.
red.exampleZh: 她今天穿着一件红色的连衣裙。

reduce.example: We can reduce waste by using less paper at home.
reduce.exampleZh: 我们可以在家里少用纸来减少浪费。

refer.example: Please refer to the map if you cannot find the station.
refer.exampleZh: 如果你找不到车站，请参考地图。

refuse.example: She refused to answer my question and walked away.
refuse.exampleZh: 她拒绝回答我的问题，然后走开了。

regard.example: Many people regard him as a kind and honest friend.
regard.exampleZh: 许多人把他看作一位善良诚实的朋友。

regret.example: I regret not saying goodbye to my grandmother before she moved away.
regret.exampleZh: 我后悔在祖母搬走前没有跟她道别。

relax.example: I like to relax with music after a long day at work.
relax.exampleZh: 工作一整天后，我喜欢听音乐放松一下。

remain.example: Only a few seats remain for tonight's show.
remain.exampleZh: 今晚的演出只剩下几个座位了。

review.exampleZh: 明天考试前我需要复习我的笔记。

rice.example: We eat rice with vegetables and fish every day.
rice.exampleZh: 我们每天吃米饭配蔬菜和鱼。

rich.example: This country is rich in oil, water, and good farm land.
rich.exampleZh: 这个国家富有石油、水源和肥沃的农田。

ride.example: I ride my bike to school every morning with my sister.

risk.example: There is a risk of rain, so take an umbrella with you.
risk.exampleZh: 有下雨的风险，所以带把伞吧。

road.example: The road to our school is long and very busy every morning.

robot.exampleZh: 这个机器人能扫地，还能帮我们做晚饭。

rock.example: The baby likes to rock in his small bed before sleep.
rock.exampleZh: 婴儿喜欢睡前在他的小床上摇晃。

role.example: Teachers play an important role in helping young students learn.
role.exampleZh: 教师在帮助年轻学生学习方面发挥着重要作用。

roll.example: The ball rolled down the hill and stopped near the old tree.
roll.exampleZh: 球滚下山坡，停在老树附近。

roof.example: The wind was so strong that it blew part of the roof away.
roof.exampleZh: 风太大了，把屋顶的一部分吹走了。

room.example: There is enough room in this small car for four people.
room.exampleZh: 这辆小汽车里足够容纳四个人。

root.example: The root of the old tree grows deep into the ground.
root.exampleZh: 这棵老树的根深深扎进土里。

rope.example: He tied the boat to the tree with a strong rope.
rope.exampleZh: 他用一根结实的绳子把船拴在树上。

rose.example: She gave her mother a red rose on her birthday.
rose.exampleZh: 她在母亲生日时送了一朵红玫瑰。

round.example: There is a round table in the middle of the room.

row.example: We sat in the front row and watched the boats row across the lake.
row.exampleZh: 我们坐在前排，看着船儿划过湖面。

rubbish.example: Please put your rubbish in the bin near the door.
rubbish.exampleZh: 请把你的垃圾放进靠近门的垃圾桶里。

rule.example: The teacher made a new rule about phones in class.
rule.exampleZh: 老师制定了关于课堂上使用手机的新规定。

ruler.example: The teacher used a ruler to draw a straight line on the board.
ruler.exampleZh: 老师用尺子在黑板上画了一条直线。

run.example: I run in the park every morning before I go to work.
run.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前去公园跑步。

rush.example: I had to rush to catch the last bus home.
rush.exampleZh: 我不得不匆忙赶去坐最后一班回家的公交车。

sad.example: She felt sad when her best friend moved away to another city.
sad.exampleZh: 当她最好的朋友搬到另一个城市时，她感到很悲伤。

safe.example: Keep your money in a safe place at home.
safe.exampleZh: 把钱放在家里安全的地方。

safety.example: Please wear a helmet for your safety when you ride a bike.
safety.exampleZh: 骑自行车时，为了你的安全请戴上头盔。

sail.example: We sail across the sea every summer with our friends.
sail.exampleZh: 每年夏天我们都和朋友一起出海航行。

salad.example: I make a fresh salad with tomatoes and lettuce for lunch.
salad.exampleZh: 我午餐用西红柿和生菜做一份新鲜沙拉。

sale.example: The store is having a big sale on shoes this weekend.
sale.exampleZh: 这家店这个周末鞋子大减价。

salt.example: Please add a little salt to the soup before you serve it.
salt.exampleZh: 上汤之前请往汤里加一点盐。

same.example: We go to the same school and we are in the same class.
same.exampleZh: 我们上同一所学校，而且在同一个班。

sand.example: The children played in the warm sand near the sea.
sand.exampleZh: 孩子们在海边温暖的沙子里玩耍。

sandwich.example: I made a ham sandwich for lunch and shared it with my sister.
sandwich.exampleZh: 我午餐做了一个火腿三明治，和妹妹一起分着吃了。

saturday.example: We will go to the park this Saturday with our friends.
saturday.exampleZh: 这个星期六我们会和朋友一起去公园。

sausage.example: I eat sausage and eggs for breakfast every morning.
sausage.exampleZh: 我每天早上吃香肠和鸡蛋。

save.example: The doctor worked all night to save the little boy's life.
save.exampleZh: 医生工作了一整夜来救那个小男孩的命。

say.example: People often say that time is more valuable than money.
say.exampleZh: 人们常说时间比金钱更有价值。

school.example: My little sister walks to school with her friends every morning.
school.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天早上和朋友们一起走路去学校。

schoolbag.example: My schoolbag is very heavy because I have five books in it.
schoolbag.exampleZh: 我的书包很重，因为里面装了五本书。

science.example: Science helps us understand the world and makes our lives better.
science.exampleZh: 科学帮助我们理解世界，也让我们的生活更美好。

scientist.example: The scientist studies plants and animals in the forest near her home.
scientist.exampleZh: 这位科学家研究她家附近森林里的植物和动物。

scissors.example: Please pass me the scissors so I can cut this paper.
scissors.exampleZh: 请把剪刀递给我，我好剪这张纸。

score.example: She got a high score on the math test, and her teacher praised her.
score.exampleZh: 她数学考试得了高分，老师表扬了她。

screen.example: The movie looked much better on the big screen.
screen.exampleZh: 这部电影在大银幕上看起来好多了。

sea.example: We swam in the sea all day last summer.
sea.exampleZh: 去年夏天我们在海里游了一整天。

search.example: We used a map to search for the old house.
search.exampleZh: 我们用地图搜寻那座老房子。

season.example: Summer is my favorite season because the days are long and sunny.
season.exampleZh: 夏天是我最喜欢的季节，因为白天漫长又阳光充足。

seat.example: Please take your seat before the film begins.

second.example: Wait a second, the second bus will come soon.
second.exampleZh: 等一下，第二班公交车马上就要来了。

secret.example: She kept her plan a secret from everyone in the office.
secret.exampleZh: 她对办公室里的每个人都保守着自己的计划秘密。

secretary.example: The secretary answered the phone and wrote down the message.
secretary.exampleZh: 秘书接了电话，并记下了留言。

see.example: I can see the big tree from my bedroom window every morning.
see.exampleZh: 我每天早上都能从卧室窗户看见那棵大树。

seem.example: You seem very tired after your long day at work today.
seem.exampleZh: 你今天工作了一整天后似乎很累。

sell.example: They sell fresh fruit and vegetables at a small shop near the station.
sell.exampleZh: 他们在车站附近的一家小店里卖新鲜水果和蔬菜。

send.example: I will send you the book by mail tomorrow morning.
send.exampleZh: 我明天早上会把这本书邮寄给你。

sense.example: She has a strong sense of what is right and wrong.
sense.exampleZh: 她对是非有很强的意识。

sentence.example: The judge will read the sentence in court tomorrow morning.
sentence.exampleZh: 法官将在明天上午在法庭上宣读判决。

september.example: My sister starts school in September this year.
september.exampleZh: 我妹妹今年九月份开始上学。

serious.exampleZh: 医生说他的病很严重，所以他必须在家休息。

servant.exampleZh: 那位老仆人打开门，把客人们迎进屋里。

serve.example: She will serve hot soup to the guests at noon.
serve.exampleZh: 她会在中午为客人们端上热汤。

service.example: The bus service in our town is cheap and easy to use.
service.exampleZh: 我们镇上的公交服务便宜又方便。

set.example: Please set the cups on the table and put the plates next to them.
set.exampleZh: 请把杯子放在桌上，并把盘子放在它们旁边。

settle.example: They decided to settle in a small town near the sea.
settle.exampleZh: 他们决定在海边的一个小镇定居。

seven.example: There are seven days in a week.

several.exampleZh: 几个学生下课后留下来问了老师几个问题。

sew.exampleZh: 我妈妈教我怎么把扣子缝到衬衫上。

shake.exampleZh: 小男孩开始摇树，想把苹果摇下来。

shall.example: We shall meet again at the same place next week.

shallow.exampleZh: 小水池里的水很浅，孩子们可以在里面玩。

shame.example: It is a shame that we cannot stay longer today.
shame.exampleZh: 我们今天不能多待一会儿，真是件遗憾的事。

shape.example: The artist used clay to shape a small bird.
shape.exampleZh: 艺术家用黏土塑造了一只小鸟。

share.example: We share one small kitchen and often cook dinner together.

sheep.exampleZh: 农夫在他家后面的绿山上养了许多羊。

sheet.example: Please put a clean sheet on the bed before the guests arrive.
sheet.exampleZh: 客人到来之前，请给床铺上一条干净床单。

shelf.example: He put the old books on the top shelf of his room.
shelf.exampleZh: 他把那些旧书放在他房间最上面的架子上。

shine.example: The sun shines brightly on the lake every morning.
shine.exampleZh: 每天早晨，阳光照在湖面上，十分明亮。

ship.example: The ship carries food and other goods across the sea every week.
ship.exampleZh: 这艘船每周运送食物和其他货物过海。

shirt.example: He wears a white shirt and a blue tie to work.

shock.example: The bad news did shock everyone in the room.

shoe.exampleZh: 我穿上新鞋，然后走去公园。

shoot.example: He likes to shoot photos of the birds in his garden.
shoot.exampleZh: 他喜欢拍摄花园里的鸟儿。

shop.example: I often shop at the small store near my home.
shop.exampleZh: 我经常在我家附近的小商店购物。

shopping.exampleZh: 我妈妈每周六早上都去我们家附近的大超市购物。

short.exampleZh: 这支蓝色钢笔对我来说太短了。

should.example: You should drink more water and get enough sleep every day.
should.exampleZh: 你应该多喝水，每天保证足够的睡眠。

shout.example: The teacher told the children not to shout in the library.
shout.exampleZh: 老师告诉孩子们不要在图书馆里大喊大叫。

show.example: The teacher will show us her new pictures after class today.
show.exampleZh: 老师今天下课后会给我们看她的新照片。

shower.example: I take a quick shower every morning before I go to work.
shower.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都会快速洗个淋浴。

shut.example: Please shut the door when you leave the room.
shut.exampleZh: 你离开房间时请把门关上。

shy.exampleZh: 那个害羞的男孩安静地坐在角落里，一言不发。

sick.exampleZh: 在聚会上吃了太多蛋糕后，我感到恶心。

silly.exampleZh: 我又把钥匙忘在家里了，真是糊涂。

since.exampleZh: 自从他去年搬到另一个城市后，我就没见过他了。

sing.exampleZh: 她喜欢在车里唱自己最喜欢的歌。

singer.exampleZh: 这位歌手为学校里的所有孩子唱了一首优美的歌。

sir.exampleZh: 打扰一下，先生，您能告诉我火车站在哪里吗？

situation.exampleZh: 这个小镇的情况一年比一年好。

six.example: My little sister is six years old and she starts school this year.
six.exampleZh: 我妹妹六岁了，她今年开始上学。

size.exampleZh: 我买这双鞋之前需要先看看尺码。

skate.exampleZh: 每年冬天，孩子们都会在家附近结冰的河面上滑冰。

skill.exampleZh: 她有很好的语言技能，与团队合作得很好。

skin.exampleZh: 她涂了防晒霜，保护皮肤不受太阳伤害。

skirt.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条蓝色的裙子去参加聚会。

sky.example: The sky is blue and clear today.

sleep.exampleZh: 我通常在工作结束后每晚睡八个小时。

slow.example: The old bus is slow, but it still gets us to school.
