somebody.example: Somebody left a small bag on the chair by the door.
somebody.exampleZh: 有人把一个小包落在门边的椅子上了。

someone.example: Someone left a bag on the chair in the park.
someone.exampleZh: 有人把一个包落在公园的椅子上。

something.example: I have something important to tell you before the meeting starts.
something.exampleZh: 在会议开始之前，我有件重要的事要告诉你。

sometimes.example: Sometimes I walk to school with my best friend.
sometimes.exampleZh: 有时我和我最好的朋友一起走路去学校。

somewhere.example: I left my keys somewhere in the kitchen this morning.
somewhere.exampleZh: 今天早上我把钥匙落在厨房的某个地方了。

son.example: My son likes to play football with his friends after school.
son.exampleZh: 我儿子喜欢放学后和朋友们一起踢足球。

song.example: She sang a beautiful song for her mother at the birthday party.
song.exampleZh: 她在生日聚会上为妈妈唱了一首优美的歌曲。

soon.example: The bus will come soon, so please wait here.
soon.exampleZh: 公交车很快就来，请在这里等一下。

sorry.example: I am sorry for being late to your party yesterday.
sorry.exampleZh: 很抱歉昨天去你的派对迟到了。

sort.example: She likes this sort of music, and I like it too.
sort.exampleZh: 她喜欢这种音乐，我也喜欢。

sound.example: The doctor said my heart sounds strong and healthy.
sound.exampleZh: 医生说我的心脏听起来强健有力。

soup.example: I eat hot soup with bread for lunch every cold day.
soup.exampleZh: 每个寒冷的日子，我午餐都吃热汤配面包。

south.example: The birds fly south every winter when the weather gets cold.
south.exampleZh: 每年冬天天气变冷时，这些鸟都会飞往南方。

space.example: There is not enough space in the car for all our bags.
space.exampleZh: 我们的车没有足够的空间放所有的包。

spare.example: I have a spare pen if you need one.
spare.exampleZh: 如果你需要，我有一支备用的笔。

speak.example: She can speak three languages and often helps her friends learn them.
speak.exampleZh: 她会说三种语言，还经常帮助朋友们学习这些语言。

special.example: This shop sells special food for babies and young children.
special.exampleZh: 这家店出售专供婴幼儿的特殊食品。

speech.example: Her speech at the meeting was short but very clear.
speech.exampleZh: 她在会上的演讲简短但非常清晰。

speed.example: The car moved at high speed down the empty road.
speed.exampleZh: 那辆车以高速在空荡的路上行驶。

spell.example: Can you spell your last name for me, please?
spell.exampleZh: 你能把你的姓拼给我听吗？

spend.example: I spend too much time on my phone every evening.
spend.exampleZh: 我每天晚上花太多时间在手机上。

spirit.example: She has a strong spirit and never gives up when life gets hard.
spirit.exampleZh: 她有坚强的精神，生活艰难时从不放弃。

spoon.example: Can you put a spoon of sugar in my tea?
spoon.exampleZh: 你能在我的茶里放一勺糖吗？

sport.example: My favorite sport is basketball, and I play it with friends every weekend.
sport.exampleZh: 我最喜欢的运动是篮球，每个周末我都和朋友们一起打。

spread.example: The news spread quickly through the small village, and everyone began to talk about it.
spread.exampleZh: 消息很快传遍了这个小村庄，大家开始议论起来。

spring.example: In spring, we like to walk by the clear spring near our house.
spring.exampleZh: 春天，我们喜欢在房子附近清澈的泉水边散步。

square.example: We walked across the square and sat on a bench.
square.exampleZh: 我们穿过广场，坐在一条长椅上。

stamp.example: I need a stamp to mail this letter to my friend.
stamp.exampleZh: 我需要一张邮票来把这封信寄给我的朋友。

stand.example: I can stand here and wait for the bus with you.
stand.exampleZh: 我可以站在这里和你一起等公交车。

star.example: The sky was clear and full of bright stars last night.
star.exampleZh: 昨晚的天空很晴朗，布满了明亮的星星。

start.example: Let us start the meeting now because everyone is already here.
start.exampleZh: 我们现在开始开会吧，因为大家都已经到了。

state.example: Please state your name and address before we begin the meeting.
state.exampleZh: 请在会议开始前说明你的姓名和地址。

station.example: The train is late, so we are waiting at the station.
station.exampleZh: 火车晚点了，所以我们正在车站等候。

stay.example: We plan to stay at a small hotel near the beach for two nights.
stay.exampleZh: 我们打算在海滩附近的一家小旅馆住两个晚上。

steal.example: He tried to steal a candy from the shop.
steal.exampleZh: 他试图从商店里偷一颗糖。

steam.example: Steam rose from the hot bowl of soup on the table.
steam.exampleZh: 热气从桌上那碗热汤里升起来。

steel.example: The bridge is made of steel and can hold heavy trucks.
steel.exampleZh: 这座桥是用钢铁制成的，能承受重型卡车。

step.example: Please take one step forward and then stop.
step.exampleZh: 请向前走一步，然后停下。

stick.example: Please stick this picture on the wall and keep it safe.
stick.exampleZh: 请把这张画粘在墙上，并保管好。

still.example: The water in the lake is still and very quiet today.
still.exampleZh: 今天湖里的水静止不动，非常平静。

stomach.example: My stomach hurts after I ate too much cake at the party.
stomach.exampleZh: 我在聚会上吃了太多蛋糕后，胃就疼了。

stone.example: The old wall was built with large grey stones from the river.
stone.exampleZh: 这堵古老的墙是用河里的大块灰色石头砌成的。

stop.example: Please stop the car near the bus stop.
stop.exampleZh: 请在公交车站附近停车。

store.example: We store extra food in the small room behind the store.
store.exampleZh: 我们把多余的食物储存在商店后面的小房间里。

storm.example: The storm broke several windows and knocked down many old trees last night.
storm.exampleZh: 昨晚的暴风雨打破了窗户，还刮倒了许多老树。

story.example: She told her little son a funny story before bed.
story.exampleZh: 她在睡前给她的小儿子讲了一个有趣的故事。

stove.example: My mother is cooking soup on the stove in the kitchen.
stove.exampleZh: 我妈妈正在厨房的炉子上煮汤。

straight.example: The road is straight and goes past our school.
straight.exampleZh: 这条路是直的，经过我们的学校。

strange.example: It is strange that nobody told me about the meeting.
strange.exampleZh: 奇怪的是，没有人告诉我关于这次会议的事。

stranger.example: My mother always tells me not to talk to a stranger on the street.
stranger.exampleZh: 我妈妈总是告诉我不要在街上和陌生人说话。

street.example: I walk down this quiet street to school every morning.
street.exampleZh: 我每天早上沿着这条安静的街道走去学校。

strength.example: She used all her strength to lift the heavy box.
strength.exampleZh: 她用尽全力抬起了那个沉重的箱子。

strict.example: Our teacher is very strict about being on time for class.
strict.exampleZh: 我们老师对上课准时要求非常严格。

strong.example: He is strong enough to carry the heavy box upstairs.
strong.exampleZh: 他足够强壮，能把那个沉重的箱子搬上楼。

student.example: The student reads a book in the library every afternoon.
student.exampleZh: 这个学生每天下午都在图书馆看书。

study.example: I study English for an hour every evening in my small study.
study.exampleZh: 我每天晚上在我的小书房里学一小时英语。

stupid.example: It is stupid to go out in the rain without an umbrella.
stupid.exampleZh: 下雨天不带伞就出门是愚蠢的。

subject.example: My favorite subject at school is English because the classes are fun.
subject.exampleZh: 我在学校最喜欢的科目是英语，因为课堂很有趣。

succeed.example: If you keep trying, you will succeed in the end.
succeed.exampleZh: 如果你继续尝试，最终会成功的。

success.example: Her hard work and patience finally led to great success in the exam.
success.exampleZh: 她的努力和耐心最终让她在考试中取得了巨大成功。

successful.example: She worked very hard and became a successful doctor in a big city.
successful.exampleZh: 她非常努力，成了大城市里一名成功的医生。

such.example: I never saw such a big dog before.
such.exampleZh: 我以前从没见过这么大的狗。

sudden.example: The sudden noise made everyone in the room jump.
sudden.exampleZh: 突然的响声让房间里的每个人都吓了一跳。

sugar.example: My mother puts two spoons of sugar in her coffee every morning.
sugar.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天早上在咖啡里放两勺糖。

suggest.example: Doctors suggest that we eat more vegetables and less sugar every day.
suggest.exampleZh: 医生建议我们每天多吃蔬菜、少吃糖。

suggestion.example: My teacher gave me a helpful suggestion about learning English.
suggestion.exampleZh: 我的老师给了我一个关于学英语的有用建议。

suit.example: This blue suit fits you well and suits the meeting.
suit.exampleZh: 这套蓝色西装很合身，也很适合这次会议。

summer.example: We swim in the lake every summer with our friends.
summer.exampleZh: 每年夏天我们都和朋友们在湖里游泳。

sun.example: The sun is very bright today, so please wear a hat.
sun.exampleZh: 今天太阳很亮，所以请戴顶帽子。

sunday.example: We often go to the park with our family on Sunday.
sunday.exampleZh: 我们经常在星期日和家人一起去公园。

sunny.example: It is a sunny day, so we can go to the park.
sunny.exampleZh: 今天天气晴朗，我们可以去公园。

supermarket.example: I buy milk and bread at the supermarket near my house.
supermarket.exampleZh: 我在我家附近的超市买牛奶和面包。

supper.example: We usually have supper at seven in the evening.
supper.exampleZh: 我们通常晚上七点吃晚饭。

supply.example: The company can supply fresh water to the whole village every day.
supply.exampleZh: 这家公司每天能为整个村庄供应新鲜水。

support.example: My parents always support me when I have difficult problems at school.
support.exampleZh: 当我在学校遇到困难时，我的父母总是支持我。

suppose.example: I suppose you are right about the meeting time.
suppose.exampleZh: 我想你在会议时间上是对的。

sure.example: I am sure that she will come to the party tonight.
sure.exampleZh: 我确信她今晚会来参加聚会。

surface.example: The surface of the lake was calm and quiet in the early morning.

surprise.example: The gift was a big surprise for her.
surprise.exampleZh: 这份礼物对她来说是个大惊喜。

survey.example: The school did a survey to find out what students like to read.
survey.exampleZh: 学校做了一项调查，了解学生喜欢读什么。

sweater.example: She wears a warm sweater when the weather turns cold.
sweater.exampleZh: 天气转冷时她会穿一件暖和的毛衣。

sweep.example: She sweeps the floor every morning before breakfast.
sweep.exampleZh: 她每天早上在早饭前扫地板。

sweet.example: My little sister has a sweet smile and loves sweet food.
sweet.exampleZh: 我妹妹有着甜美的笑容，而且喜欢甜食。

swim.example: I like to swim in the lake near my house every summer.
swim.exampleZh: 我喜欢每年夏天在房子附近的湖里游泳。

switch.example: Please switch off the lights before you leave the room.
switch.exampleZh: 离开房间前请把灯关掉。

sword.example: The old king gave his son a sharp sword and a strong shield.
sword.exampleZh: 老国王给了儿子一把锋利的剑和一面坚固的盾。

symbol.example: The dove is a symbol of peace in many cultures.
symbol.exampleZh: 在许多文化中，鸽子是和平的象征。

system.example: Our school has a new system for lending books to students.
system.exampleZh: 我们学校有一套新的学生借书系统。

t-shirt.example: He wore a white t-shirt and blue jeans to the park.
t-shirt.exampleZh: 他穿着白色T恤衫和蓝色牛仔裤去了公园。

table.example: We put the books on the table near the window.
table.exampleZh: 我们把书放在窗户附近的桌子上。

tail.example: The dog wagged its tail happily when I came home.
tail.exampleZh: 我回家时，那只狗高兴地摇着尾巴。

take.example: Please take this box to my office and leave it on the desk.
take.exampleZh: 请把这个箱子拿到我办公室，放在桌子上。

talk.example: We can talk about your plan after lunch today.
talk.exampleZh: 我们今天午饭之后可以谈谈你的计划。

tall.example: The tall man is my father and he works in a bank.
tall.exampleZh: 那个高个子男人是我父亲，他在一家银行工作。

tank.example: The old car has a small tank, so we stop often for gas.
tank.exampleZh: 这辆旧车的油箱很小，所以我们经常停下来加油。

tap.example: She turned off the tap and dried her hands with a clean towel.
tap.exampleZh: 她关上水龙头，用一条干净的毛巾擦干了手。

tape.example: Please put the tape back in the box after you use it.
tape.exampleZh: 用完后请把胶带放回盒子里。

task.example: My first task today is to clean the kitchen.
task.exampleZh: 我今天的第一项任务是打扫厨房。

taste.example: This soup tastes very good, and I want to taste it again.
taste.exampleZh: 这汤尝起来很不错，我想再尝一次。

taxi.example: We took a taxi to the airport early this morning.
taxi.exampleZh: 我们今天一早乘出租车去了机场。

tea.example: My mother drinks a cup of hot tea every morning before work.
tea.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天早上上班前都会喝一杯热茶。

teach.example: My mother teaches English at a small school near our home.
teach.exampleZh: 我妈妈在我们家附近的一所小学教英语。

teacher.example: My English teacher gives us interesting homework and helps us after class.
teacher.exampleZh: 我的英语老师给我们布置有趣的作业，并在课后帮助我们。

team.example: Our team works well together and finishes every project on time.
team.exampleZh: 我们的团队合作得很好，总能按时完成每个项目。

telephone.example: I called her on the telephone to say happy birthday.
telephone.exampleZh: 我打电话给她祝她生日快乐。

television.example: My little brother watches cartoons on television every morning before school.
television.exampleZh: 我弟弟每天早上上学前都会在电视上看卡通片。

tell.example: Please tell me the truth about what happened last night.
tell.exampleZh: 请告诉我昨晚发生的事情真相。

temperature.example: The temperature is very high today, so we will stay at home.
temperature.exampleZh: 今天温度很高，所以我们会待在家里。

ten.example: There are ten students in the small classroom today.
ten.exampleZh: 今天这间小教室里有十个学生。

tennis.example: My sister and I play tennis in the park every Sunday morning.
tennis.exampleZh: 我和姐姐每个星期天早上都在公园里打网球。

tent.example: We put up a tent near the lake and slept there all night.
tent.exampleZh: 我们在湖边搭了一个帐篷，在那里睡了一整夜。

term.example: The new term starts next Monday, and we will meet our teacher then.
term.exampleZh: 新学期下周一开始，到时我们会见到我们的老师。

terrible.example: The weather was terrible, so we stayed home all day.
terrible.exampleZh: 天气很糟糕，所以我们一整天都待在家里。

test.example: We have a math test tomorrow, so I need to study tonight.
test.exampleZh: 我们明天有一场数学考试，所以今晚我需要复习。

text.example: Please read the text on page ten and answer my question.
text.exampleZh: 请朗读第十页的课文，然后回答我的问题。

than.example: She runs faster than her brother does.

thank.example: I want to thank you for your help with my work today.
thank.exampleZh: 我想感谢你今天对我工作的帮助。

that.example: I know that she likes that blue bag.
that.exampleZh: 我知道她喜欢那个蓝色的包。

the.example: The cat sat on the mat near the old wooden door.
the.exampleZh: 那只猫坐在旧木门旁边的垫子上。

theatre.example: We went to the theatre last night to see a famous play.
theatre.exampleZh: 我们昨晚去剧院看了一场著名的戏剧。

their.example: Their house is near the school, so the children walk there every day.
their.exampleZh: 他们的房子在学校附近，所以孩子们每天走路去那里。

theirs.example: This bag is mine, and the blue one is theirs.
theirs.exampleZh: 这个包是我的，那个蓝色的是他们的。

them.example: I gave the books to them after school yesterday.
them.exampleZh: 昨天放学后我把那些书给了他们。

themselves.example: The children made the cake themselves without any help from their parents.
themselves.exampleZh: 孩子们自己做了蛋糕，没有父母帮忙。

then.example: I finished my homework, and then I went out to play.
then.exampleZh: 我做完作业，然后就出去玩了。

there.example: There is a small park near my house, and we play there every day.
there.exampleZh: 我家附近有一个小公园，我们每天在那里玩。

these.example: These books on the desk are mine, and those are yours.
these.exampleZh: 桌上这些书是我的，那些是你的。

they.example: They are my friends and we play football together every day.
they.exampleZh: 他们是我的朋友，我们每天一起踢足球。

thick.example: The ice on the lake is very thick and safe to walk on.
thick.exampleZh: 湖面上的冰很厚，走在上面很安全。

thin.example: The ice on the lake is too thin to walk on.
thin.exampleZh: 湖面上的冰太薄了，不能在上面走。

thing.example: The first thing I do every morning is drink a glass of water.
thing.exampleZh: 我每天早上做的第一件事就是喝一杯水。

think.example: I think this book is very good for you.
think.exampleZh: 我认为这本书对你很有好处。

third.example: Our team finished third in the school football match last Friday.
third.exampleZh: 我们队上周五在学校足球比赛中获得第三名。

thirsty.example: After the long run, I felt very thirsty and drank two glasses of water.
thirsty.exampleZh: 长跑之后，我感到非常口渴，喝了两杯水。

thirteen.example: My little sister is thirteen years old and she loves reading books.
thirteen.exampleZh: 我妹妹十三岁，她喜欢读书。

thirty.example: My mother is thirty years old, and she teaches at a small school.
thirty.exampleZh: 我妈妈三十岁，她在一所小学校教书。

this.example: This is my new book, and I read it every day.
this.exampleZh: 这是我的新书，我每天都读它。

those.example: Those are my books on the desk, not yours.
those.exampleZh: 桌上那些是我的书，不是你的。

though.example: Though it was raining hard, we still walked to the park.
though.exampleZh: 虽然雨下得很大，我们还是走路去了公园。

thought.example: That thought made me smile all day long.
thought.exampleZh: 那个想法让我笑了一整天。

thousand.example: Our small town has about one thousand people living in it.
thousand.exampleZh: 我们的小镇大约有一千人居住。

thread.example: I need a needle and some red thread to fix this shirt.
thread.exampleZh: 我需要一根针和一些红线来补这件衬衫。

three.example: My little sister is three years old and she likes to sing.
three.exampleZh: 我的小妹妹三岁了，她喜欢唱歌。

through.example: The train went through the long tunnel and came out in bright sunlight.
through.exampleZh: 火车穿过长长的隧道，驶入明亮的阳光中。

throw.example: Please throw the ball to me, not at the window.
throw.exampleZh: 请把球扔给我，不要扔向窗户。

thursday.example: We will have our English test next Thursday morning.
thursday.exampleZh: 我们下周四上午将进行英语考试。

ticket.example: I bought two train tickets to Beijing for my parents.
ticket.exampleZh: 我给父母买了两张去北京的火车票。

tidy.example: Please tidy your room and keep your desk tidy.
tidy.exampleZh: 请整理你的房间，并保持书桌整洁。

tie.example: He wears a blue tie to work and ties his shoes before leaving.
tie.exampleZh: 他上班系蓝色领带，出门前系好鞋带。

tiger.example: The tiger sleeps under a big tree in the zoo.
tiger.exampleZh: 那只老虎在动物园里的一棵大树下睡觉。

tight.example: She held the rope tight so it would not slip.
tight.exampleZh: 她把绳子拉得很紧，这样它就不会滑脱。

till.example: We waited at the station till the last train came.
till.exampleZh: 我们在车站一直等到最后一班火车到来。

time.example: I do not have much time to finish my work today.
time.exampleZh: 我今天没有太多时间完成我的工作。

timetable.example: Our new timetable shows that math class is on Monday morning.
timetable.exampleZh: 我们的新课程表显示数学课在周一上午。

tiny.example: A tiny bird landed on the branch outside my window.
tiny.exampleZh: 一只极小的鸟落在我窗外的树枝上。

tip.example: She gave me a useful tip about saving money.
tip.exampleZh: 她给了我一个关于省钱的实用建议。

tired.example: After a long day at work, I feel very tired and want to sleep.
tired.exampleZh: 工作了一整天后，我感到非常累，很想睡觉。

to.example: I walk to school with my sister every morning.
to.exampleZh: 我每天早上和妹妹一起走路去学校。

today.example: I have a lot of work to do today, so I cannot go out.
today.exampleZh: 我今天有很多工作要做，所以不能出去。

together.example: We often cook dinner together and talk about our day.
together.exampleZh: 我们经常一起做晚饭，聊聊各自的一天。

toilet.example: The toilet in our school is clean and bright.

yesterday.exampleZh: 昨天我在那家小咖啡店里见到了我的老朋友。

yet.example: I have not finished my homework yet, but I am almost done.
yet.exampleZh: 我还没有完成作业，但我快做完了。

you.example: You can borrow my book if you need it today.
you.exampleZh: 如果你今天需要，你可以借我的书。

young.example: My young brother is only five years old and loves to play outside.
young.exampleZh: 我年幼的弟弟只有五岁，喜欢在外面玩。

your.example: Please put your books on the desk before the class starts.
your.exampleZh: 请在上课前把你的书放在桌子上。

yours.example: This book is mine and that one over there is yours.
yours.exampleZh: 这本书是我的，那边那本是你的。

yourself.example: You should be proud of yourself for finishing the hard work today.
yourself.exampleZh: 你今天完成了这项艰难的工作，应该为自己感到骄傲。

zebra.example: The zebra has black and white stripes on its body.
zebra.exampleZh: 这只斑马身上有黑白相间的条纹。

zero.example: The temperature dropped below zero last night, so the lake froze.
zero.exampleZh: 昨晚气温降到零度以下，所以湖面结冰了。

zoo.example: We took the children to the zoo to see the lions and monkeys.
zoo.exampleZh: 我们带孩子们去动物园看狮子和猴子。
